themes.title: Wudu, the masjid and the adhan

title.en: Blessings on the Prophet after the tashahhud
title.ar: الصَّلَاةُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَعْدَ التَّشَهُّدِ

title.en: After the final tashahhud, before the salam
title.ar: الدُّعَاءُ بَعْدَ التَّشَهُّدِ الأَخِيرِ وَقَبْلَ السَّلَامِ

title.en: After the salam of the witr prayer
When frightened in sleep or uneasy
title.ar: دُعَاءُ الفَزَعِ فِي النَّوْمِ وَمَنْ بُلِيَ بِالوَحْشَةِ

title.en: After a good or bad dream
title.ar: مَا يَفْعَلُ مَنْ رَأَى الرُّؤْيَا أَوِ الحُلُمَ

title.en: Meeting an enemy or a person in authority
When fearing a group of people

title.ar: دُعَاءُ مَنْ أَصَابَهُ شَكٌّ فِي الِإيمَانِ

title.en: Driving away Satan and his whispers

title.ar: الدُّعَاءُ حِينَمَا يَقَعُ مَا لَا يَرْضَاهُ أَوْ غُلِبَ عَلَى أَمْرِهِ

title.en: Against the plots of rebellious devils
title.ar: مَا يَقُولُ لِرَدِّ كَيْدِ مَرَدَةِ الشَّيَاطِينِ
مَا يَقُولُ وَيَفْعَلُ مَنْ أَذْنَبَ ذَنْبًا
مَا يَعْصِمُ اللَّهُ بِهِ مِنَ الدَّجَّالِ

title.en: For the sick when visiting them
When the sick have lost hope of life
title.ar: دُعَاءُ المَرِيضِ الذِي يَئِسَ مِنْ حَيَاتِهِ

title.en: When closing the eyes of the deceased
For the deceased in the funeral prayer
For a child in the funeral prayer
Placing the deceased in the grave

title.ar: مَا يَقُولُ مَنْ أَحَسَّ وَجَعًا فِي جَسَدِهِ

title.en: When afraid of harming something with the evil eye
title.ar: دُعَاءُ مَنْ خَشِيَ أَنْ يُصِيبَ شَيْئًا بِعَيْنِهِ

title.en: Congratulating on a newborn, and the reply
On marrying or buying an animal
Asking for the rain to stop
On seeing the first fruits of the season
On hearing a rooster crow or a donkey bray
title.ar: الدُّعَاءُ عِنْدَ صِيَاحِ الدِّيكِ وَنَهِيقِ الحِمَارِ

title.en: On hearing dogs bark at night
title.ar: الدُّعَاءُ عِنْدَ سَمَاعِ نُبَاحِ الكِلَابِ بِاللَّيْلِ

title.en: A guest's dua for the host
For someone who gives you a drink
title.ar: الدُّعَاءُ لِمَنْ سَقَاهُ أَوْ إِذَا أَرَادَ ذَلِكَ

title.en: When breaking the fast with a household
title.ar: الدُّعَاءُ إِذَا أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍ

title.en: When a fasting person is invited to a meal
title.ar: دُعَاءُ الصَّائِمِ إِذَا حَضَرَ الطَّعَامُ وَلَمْ يُفْطِرْ

title.en: When someone insults a fasting person
title.ar: مَا يَقُولُ الصَّائِمُ إِذَا سَابَّهُ أَحَدٌ

title.en: When a non-Muslim sneezes and praises Allah
title.ar: مَا يُقَالُ لِلْكَافِرِ إِذَا عَطَسَ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ

title.en: When someone says 'May Allah forgive you'
title.ar: الدُّعَاءُ لِمَنْ قَالَ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَكَ

title.en: For someone who does you a kindness
When someone says 'I love you for Allah's sake'
title.ar: الدُّعَاءُ لِمَنْ قَالَ إِنِّي أُحِبُّكَ فِي اللَّهِ

title.en: When someone offers you their wealth
When someone says 'May Allah bless you'
title.ar: الدُّعَاءُ لِمَنْ قَالَ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ فِيكَ

title.en: When something pleasing or displeasing happens
title.ar: مَا يَقُولُ مَنْ أَتَاهُ أَمْرٌ يَسُرُّهُ أَوْ يَكْرَهُهُ

title.en: Returning the greeting of a non-Muslim
title.ar: كَيْفَ يَرُدُّ السَّلَامُ عَلَى الكَافِرِ إِذَا سَلَّمَ
مَا يَقُولُ المُسْلِمُ إِذَا مَدَحَ المُسْلِمَ

title.en: What to do on receiving good news
title.ar: مَا يَفْعَلُ مَنْ أَتَاهُ أَمْرٌ يَسُرُّهُ

title.en: The traveller's farewell to those staying behind

title.ar: الدُّعَاءُ إِذَا نَزَلَ مَنْزِلًا فِي سَفَرٍ أَوْ غَيْرِهِ

title.en: The talbiyah for Hajj or Umrah
title.ar: كَيْفَ يُلَبِّي المُحْرِمُ فِي الحَجِّ أَوْ العُمْرَةِ

title.en: Between the Yemeni Corner and the Black Stone
title.ar: الدُّعَاءُ بَيْنَ الرُّكْنِ اليَمَانِي وَالحَجَرِ الأَسْوَدِ

title.en: Takbir with each pebble at the Jamarat
title.ar: التَّكْبِيرُ عِنْدَ رَمْيِ الجِمَارِ مَعَ كُلِّ حَصَاةٍ
مَا يَقُولُ عِنْدَ الذَّبْحِ أَوْ النَّحْرِ

occasion-1-1.arabic: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَمَا أَمَاتَنَا، وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُّورُ
occasion-1-1.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāhil-ladhī aḥyānā baʿda mā amātanā wa ilayhin-nushūr.
occasion-1-1.translation: All praise is for Allah, who gave us life after He had caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 11/113; Muslim 4/2083
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 11/ 113 ومسلم 4/ 2083

occasion-1-2.arabic: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي، وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ
occasion-1-2.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāhil-ladhī ʿāfānī fī jasadī, wa radda ʿalayya rūḥī, wa adhina lī bi-dhikrih.
occasion-1-2.translation: All praise is for Allah, who granted me well-being in my body, returned my soul to me, and permitted me to remember Him.

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi 5/473; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/144
reference.ar: التّرمذي 5/ 473 وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 144

occasion-1-3.arabic: (لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّه، وَاللَّه أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ العَلِّي العَظِيمِ، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي). أَوْ دَعَا اسْتُجِيبَ لَهُ فَإِنْ تَوَضَّأَ وَصَلَّى قُبِلَتْ صَلَاتَهُ
occasion-1-3.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamd, wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr, subḥānallāh, wal-ḥamdu lillāh, wa lā ilāha illallāh, wallāhu akbar, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāhil-ʿaliyyil-ʿaẓīm, rabbighfir lī.
occasion-1-3.translation: (There is none worthy of worship but Allah alone, without any partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is able to do all things. Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, there is none worthy of worship but Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no might and no power except with Allah, the Most High, the Most Great. My Lord, forgive me.) Or if he supplicates, he will be answered; and if he performs ablution and prays, his prayer will be accepted.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 3/144 and others, the wording being that of Ibn Majah; see also Sahih Ibn Majah 2/335
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 3/ 144 وغيرها واللفظ لابن ماجه انظر صحيح ابن ماجه 2/ 335

occasion-1-4.arabic: {إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآيَاتٍ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ (190) الَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ قِيَامًا وَقُعُودًا وَعَلَى جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ (191) رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَنْ تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنْصَارٍ (192) رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ (193) رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدْتَنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ (194) فَاسْتَجَابَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ أَنِّي لَا أُضِيعُ عَمَلَ عَامِلٍ مِنْكُمْ مِنْ ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنْثَى بَعْضُكُمْ مِنْ بَعْضٍ فَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا وَأُخْرِجُوا مِنْ دِيَارِهِمْ وَأُوذُوا فِي سَبِيلِي وَقَاتَلُوا وَقُتِلُوا لَأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَلَأُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ثَوَابًا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ عِنْدَهُ حُسْنُ الثَّوَابِ (195) لَا يَغُرَّنَّكَ تَقَلُّبُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي الْبِلَادِ (196) مَتَاعٌ قَلِيلٌ ثُمَّ مَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ (197) لَكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا نُزُلًا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ وَمَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لِلْأَبْرَارِ (198) وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَمَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ خَاشِعِينَ لِلَّهِ لَا يَشْتَرُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا أُولَئِكَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ (199) يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اصْبِرُوا وَصَابِرُوا وَرَابِطُوا وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ (200)} سورة آل عمران، 190 – 200
occasion-1-4.transliteration: Inna fī khalqis-samāwāti wal-arḍi wakhtilāfil-layli wan-nahāri la-āyātin li-ulil-albāb. Alladhīna yadhkurūnallāha qiyāman wa quʿūdan wa ʿalā junūbihim wa yatafakkarūna fī khalqis-samāwāti wal-arḍ, rabbanā mā khalaqta hādhā bāṭilā, subḥānaka fa-qinā ʿadhāban-nār. Rabbanā innaka man tudkhilin-nāra faqad akhzaytah, wa mā liẓ-ẓālimīna min anṣār. Rabbanā innanā samiʿnā munādiyan yunādī lil-īmāni an āminū bi-rabbikum fa-āmannā, rabbanā faghfir lanā dhunūbanā wa kaffir ʿannā sayyiʾātinā wa tawaffanā maʿal-abrār. Rabbanā wa ātinā mā waʿadtanā ʿalā rusulika wa lā tukhzinā yawmal-qiyāmah, innaka lā tukhliful-mīʿād. Fastajāba lahum rabbuhum annī lā uḍīʿu ʿamala ʿāmilin minkum min dhakarin aw unthā, baʿḍukum min baʿḍ, falladhīna hājarū wa ukhrijū min diyārihim wa ūdhū fī sabīlī wa qātalū wa qutilū la-ukaffiranna ʿanhum sayyiʾātihim wa la-udkhilannahum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihal-anhāru thawāban min ʿindillāh, wallāhu ʿindahu ḥusnuth-thawāb. Lā yaghurrannaka taqallubul-ladhīna kafarū fil-bilād. Matāʿun qalīlun thumma maʾwāhum jahannam, wa biʾsal-mihād. Lākinil-ladhīnat-taqaw rabbahum lahum jannātun tajrī min taḥtihal-anhāru khālidīna fīhā nuzulan min ʿindillāh, wa mā ʿindallāhi khayrun lil-abrār. Wa inna min ahlil-kitābi la-man yuʾminu billāhi wa mā unzila ilaykum wa mā unzila ilayhim khāshiʿīna lillāhi lā yashtarūna bi-āyātillāhi thamanan qalīlā, ulāʾika lahum ajruhum ʿinda rabbihim, innallāha sarīʿul-ḥisāb. Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanuṣ-birū wa ṣābirū wa rābiṭū wattaqullāha laʿallakum tufliḥūn.
occasion-1-4.translation: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day are signs for people of understanding: those who remember Allah standing, sitting and lying on their sides, and reflect on the creation of the heavens and the earth, saying: 'Our Lord, You did not create this in vain. Glory be to You; so protect us from the punishment of the Fire. Our Lord, whoever You admit into the Fire, You have truly disgraced him, and the wrongdoers will have no helpers. Our Lord, we have heard a caller calling to faith, saying: Believe in your Lord, and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins, remove from us our misdeeds, and take us in death among the righteous. Our Lord, grant us what You promised us through Your messengers, and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You never break Your promise.' And their Lord answered them: 'I will not let the deed of any doer among you be lost, whether male or female; you are of one another. So those who emigrated, were driven out of their homes, were harmed in My cause, and fought and were killed, I will surely remove from them their misdeeds and admit them into gardens beneath which rivers flow, as a reward from Allah; and with Allah is the best reward.' Do not be deceived by the movement of the disbelievers throughout the land. It is a brief enjoyment; then their refuge is Hell, and what a wretched resting place. But those who fear their Lord will have gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding in them forever, a welcome from Allah; and what is with Allah is best for the righteous. And indeed, among the People of the Book are those who believe in Allah and in what was revealed to you and what was revealed to them, humbling themselves before Allah; they do not sell the verses of Allah for a small price. Those will have their reward with their Lord. Indeed, Allah is swift in account. O you who believe, be patient, outdo one another in patience, stand firm, and fear Allah so that you may succeed. (Al Imran 3:190-200)

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 8/238; Muslim 1/530
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 8/ 238 ومسلم 1/ 530

occasion-2-1.arabic: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا ( الثَّوْبَ ) وَرَزَقَنِيه مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
occasion-2-1.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāhil-ladhī kasānī hādhath-thawba wa razaqanīhi min ghayri ḥawlin minnī wa lā quwwah.
occasion-2-1.translation: All praise is for Allah, who clothed me with this (garment) and provided it for me without any might or power on my part.

reference.en: Recorded by the authors of the Sunan except an-Nasa'i; see also Irwa' al-Ghalil 7/47
reference.ar: أخرجه أهل السنن إلا النسائي انظر إرواء الغليل 7/ 47

occasion-3-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوتَنِيه، أسْألك مِنْ خَيرِهِ وخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شرِّه وشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
occasion-3-1.transliteration: Allāhumma lakal-ḥamdu anta kasawtanīh, asʾaluka min khayrihi wa khayri mā ṣuniʿa lah, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri mā ṣuniʿa lah.
occasion-3-1.translation: O Allah, to You belongs all praise; You have clothed me with it. I ask You for its good and the good for which it was made, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil for which it was made.

reference.en: Abu Dawud, at-Tirmidhi and al-Baghawi; see also Mukhtasar Shama'il at-Tirmidhi by al-Albani p. 47
reference.ar: أبو داود والتّرمذي والبغوي وانظر مختصر شمائل التّرمذي للألباني ص 47

occasion-4-1.arabic: إِلْبَسْ جَدِيدًا وَعِشْ حَمِيدًا وَمُتْ شَهِيدًا
occasion-4-1.transliteration: Ilbas jadīdā, wa ʿish ḥamīdā, wa mut shahīdā.
occasion-4-1.translation: Wear new clothes, live a praiseworthy life, and die a martyr.

reference.en: Ibn Majah 2/1178; al-Baghawi 12/41; see also Sahih Ibn Majah 2/275
reference.ar: ابن ماجه 2/ 1178 والبغوي 12/ 41 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجة 2/ 275

occasion-4-2.translation: May you wear it out, and may Allah the Most High replace it.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 4/41; see also Sahih Abi Dawud 2/760
reference.ar: أخرجه أبو داود 4/ 41، وانظر صحيح أبي داود 2/ 760

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi 2/505 and others; see also al-Irwa' no. 49; Sahih al-Jami' 3/203
reference.ar: التّرمذي 2/ 505 وغيره وانظر الإرواء برقم 49 صحيح الجامع 3/ 203

occasion-6-1.arabic: [بِسْمِ اللَّه]، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الخُبْثِ وَالخَبَائِثِ
occasion-6-1.transliteration: Bismillāh. Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika minal-khubthi wal-khabāʾith.
occasion-6-1.translation: [In the name of Allah.] O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the male and female devils.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 1/45; Muslim 1/283; the addition of 'In the name of Allah' at the beginning was recorded by Sa'id ibn Mansur; see also Fath al-Bari 1/244
reference.ar: أخرجه البخاري 1/ 45 ومسلم 1/ 283 وزيادة (بسم الله) في أوله، أخرجها سعيد بن منصور، أنظر فتح الباري 1/ 244

reference.en: Recorded by the authors of the Sunan except an-Nasa'i, who recorded it in 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah; see also Takhrij Zad al-Ma'ad 2/387
reference.ar: أخرجه أصحاب السنن إلا النسائي، أخرجه في عمل اليوم والليلة انظر تخريج زاد المعاد 2/ 387

occasion-10-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ أَوْ أُضَلَّ أَوْ أَزِلَّ، أو أُزَلَّ، أَوْ أَظْلِم أَوْ أُظْلَمَ، أَوْ أَجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ
occasion-10-1.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika an aḍilla aw uḍalla, aw azilla aw uzalla, aw aẓlima aw uẓlama, aw ajhala aw yujhala ʿalayy.
occasion-10-1.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from going astray or being led astray, from slipping or being made to slip, from doing wrong or being wronged, and from behaving foolishly or being treated foolishly.

reference.en: The authors of the Sunan; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/152; Sahih Ibn Majah 2/336
reference.ar: أهل السنن وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 152 وصحيح ابن ماجه 2/ 336

occasion-10-2.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
occasion-10-2.transliteration: Bismillāh, tawakkaltu ʿalallāh, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh.
occasion-10-2.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might and no power except with Allah.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 4/325; at-Tirmidhi 5/490; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/151
reference.ar: أبو داود 4/ 325 والتّرمذي 5/ 490 وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 151

occasion-11-1.arabic: بِسْمِ اللًّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا. ثُمَّ لِيُسَلِّمْ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ
occasion-11-1.transliteration: Bismillāhi walajnā, wa bismillāhi kharajnā, wa ʿalallāhi rabbinā tawakkalnā.
occasion-11-1.translation: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah, our Lord, we place our trust. Then let him greet his family with peace.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 4/325, and al-'Allamah Ibn Baz graded its chain good in Tuhfat al-Akhyar p. 28. In the Sahih: (When a man enters his house and remembers Allah on entering and at his meal, Satan says: You have no place to stay and no supper) Muslim no. 2018
reference.ar: أخرجه أبو داود 4/ 325، وحسن إسناده العلامة ابن باز في تحفة الأخيار ص 28، وفي الصحيح (إذا دخل الرجل بيته فذكر بيته فذكر الله عند دخوله وعند طعامه قال الشيطان لا مبيت لكم ولا عشاء) مسلم برقم 2018

reference.en: Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah and Ahmad; see also Irwa' al-Ghalil 1/122
reference.ar: أبو داود وابن ماجه وأحمد وانظر إرواء الغليل 1/ 122

occasion-9-1.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
occasion-9-1.transliteration: Ashhadu an lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, wa ashhadu anna Muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa rasūluh.
occasion-9-1.translation: I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but Allah alone, without any partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger.

reference.en: Muslim 1/209
reference.ar: رواه مسلم 1/ 209

occasion-9-2.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ المُتَطَهِّرِينَ
occasion-9-2.translation: O Allah, make me among those who repent often, and make me among those who purify themselves.

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi 1/78; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 1/18
reference.ar: التّرمذي 1/ 78 وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 1/ 18

occasion-9-3.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
occasion-9-3.transliteration: Subḥānakallāhumma wa bi-ḥamdik, ashhadu an lā ilāha illā ant, astaghfiruka wa atūbu ilayk.
occasion-9-3.translation: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You. I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but You. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.

reference.en: An-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah p. 173; see also Irwa' al-Ghalil 1/135 and 2/94
reference.ar: النسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة ص 173 وانظر إرواء الغليل 1/ 135 و 2/ 94

occasion-12-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا، وَفِي لِسَانِي نُورًا، وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا، وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ تَحْتِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي نُورا، وَمِنْ أَمَامِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ فِي نَفْسِي نُورًا، وَأَعْظِمْ لِي نُورًا، وَعَظِّمْ لِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْنِي نُورًا. اللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ فِي عَصَبِي نُورًا، وَفِي لَحْمِي نُورًا، وَفِي دَمِي نُورًا، وَفِي شَعْرِي نُورًا، وَفِي بَشَرِي نُورًا
occasion-12-1.transliteration: Allāhummajʿal fī qalbī nūrā, wa fī lisānī nūrā, wa fī samʿī nūrā, wa fī baṣarī nūrā, wa min fawqī nūrā, wa min taḥtī nūrā, wa ʿan yamīnī nūrā, wa ʿan shimālī nūrā, wa min amāmī nūrā, wa min khalfī nūrā, wajʿal fī nafsī nūrā, wa aʿẓim lī nūrā, wa ʿaẓẓim lī nūrā, wajʿal lī nūrā, wajʿalnī nūrā. Allāhumma aʿṭinī nūrā, wajʿal fī ʿaṣabī nūrā, wa fī laḥmī nūrā, wa fī damī nūrā, wa fī shaʿrī nūrā, wa fī basharī nūrā.
occasion-12-1.translation: O Allah, place light in my heart, light on my tongue, light in my hearing, light in my sight, light above me, light below me, light on my right, light on my left, light in front of me and light behind me. Place light in my soul, make the light great for me, magnify the light for me, grant me light and make me light. O Allah, give me light, and place light in my sinews, light in my flesh, light in my blood, light in my hair and light in my skin.

reference.en: All of these phrases are in al-Bukhari 11/116 no. 6316; Muslim 1/526, 529, 530 no. 763
reference.ar: جميع هذه الخصال في البخاري 11/ 116 برقم 6316 ومسلم 1/ 526، 529، 530 برقم 763

occasion-12-2.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِي نُورًا فِي قَبْرِي .. وَنُورًا فِي عِظَامِي
occasion-12-2.transliteration: Allāhummajʿal lī nūran fī qabrī, wa nūran fī ʿiẓāmī.
occasion-12-2.translation: O Allah, place light for me in my grave ... and light in my bones.

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi no. 3419, 5/483
reference.ar: التّرمذي برقم 3419، 5/ 483

occasion-12-3.arabic: وَزِدْنِي نُورًا، وَزِدْنِي نُورًا، وَزِدْنِي نُورًا
occasion-12-3.transliteration: Wa zidnī nūrā, wa zidnī nūrā, wa zidnī nūrā.
occasion-12-3.translation: And increase me in light, and increase me in light, and increase me in light.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-Mufrad no. 695, p. 258; al-Albani graded its chain authentic in Sahih al-Adab al-Mufrad no. 536
reference.ar: أخرجه البخاري في الأدب المفرد برقم 695، ص 258 وصحح إسناده الألباني في صحيح الأدب المفرد برقم 536

occasion-12-4.transliteration: Wa hab lī nūran ʿalā nūr.
occasion-12-4.translation: And grant me light upon light.

reference.en: Mentioned by Ibn Hajar in Fath al-Bari, who attributed it to Ibn Abi 'Asim in Kitab ad-Du'a; see also al-Fath 11/118, where he said: Combining the different narrations gives twenty-five phrases
reference.ar: ذكره ابن حجر في فتح الباري وعزاه إلى ابن أبي عاصم في كتاب الدعاء، انظر الفتح 11/ 118 وقال: فاجتمع من اختلاف الروايات خمس وعشرون خصلة

occasion-13-1.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ العَظِيمِ، وَبِوَجْهِهِ الكَرِيمِ، وَسُلْطَانِهِ القَدِيمِ، مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
occasion-13-1.transliteration: Aʿūdhu billāhil-ʿaẓīm, wa bi-wajhihil-karīm, wa sulṭānihil-qadīm, minash-shayṭānir-rajīm.
occasion-13-1.translation: I seek refuge in Allah the Almighty, in His noble Face and His eternal authority, from Satan the outcast.

reference.en: Abu Dawud; see also Sahih al-Jami' no. 4591
reference.ar: أبو داود وانظر صحيح الجامع برقم 4591

occasion-13-2.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ* وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ** اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ***
occasion-13-2.transliteration: Bismillāh, waṣ-ṣalātu was-salāmu ʿalā rasūlillāh, Allāhummaftaḥ lī abwāba raḥmatik.
occasion-13-2.translation: In the name of Allah, and may blessings and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.

reference.en: Ibn as-Sunni no. 88, graded good by al-Albani; Abu Dawud 1/126; see also Sahih al-Jami' 1/528; Muslim 1/494. In Sunan Ibn Majah, from the hadith of Fatimah (may Allah be pleased with her): (O Allah, forgive me my sins and open for me the gates of Your mercy), which al-Albani graded authentic through its supporting narrations; see also Sahih Ibn Majah 1/128-129
reference.ar: * رواه ابن السني برقم 88 وحسنه الألباني ** أبو داود 1/ 126 وانظر صحيح الجامع 1/ 528 *** رواه مسلم 1/ 494. وفي سنن ابن ماجه من حديث فاطمة رضي الله عنها (اللهم اغفر لي ذنوبي وافتح لي أبواب رحمتك) وصححه الألباني لشواهده، انظر صحيح ابن ماجه 1/ 128 - 129

occasion-14-1.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
occasion-14-1.transliteration: Bismillāhi waṣ-ṣalātu was-salāmu ʿalā rasūlillāh, Allāhumma innī asʾaluka min faḍlik, Allāhummaʿṣimnī minash-shayṭānir-rajīm.
occasion-14-1.translation: In the name of Allah, and may blessings and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty. O Allah, protect me from Satan the outcast.

reference.en: See the sources of the narrations of the previous hadith, no. 20; the addition (O Allah, protect me from Satan the outcast) is from Ibn Majah; see also Sahih Ibn Majah 1/129
reference.ar: انظر تخريج روايات الحديث السابق رقم 20 وزيادة (اللهم اعصمني من الشيطان الرجيم) لابن ماجه. انظر صحيح ابن ماجه 1/ 129

occasion-15-1.arabic: يَقُولُ مِثْلَ مَا يَقُولُ المُؤَذِّنُ إِلَّا فِي (حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ) وَ (حَيَّ عَلَى الفَلَاحِ) فَيَقُولُ (لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ)
occasion-15-1.transliteration: Lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh.
occasion-15-1.translation: He says the same as the muezzin says, except at 'Come to prayer' and 'Come to success', where he says: 'There is no might and no power except with Allah.'

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 1/152; Muslim 1/288
reference.ar: البخاري 1/ 152 ومسلم 1/ 288

occasion-15-2.arabic: وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولًا وَبِالإِسْلَامِ دِينًا
occasion-15-2.transliteration: Wa anā ashhadu an lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, wa anna Muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa rasūluh, raḍītu billāhi rabbā, wa bi-Muḥammadin rasūlā, wa bil-islāmi dīnā.
occasion-15-2.translation: And I too bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but Allah alone, without any partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger. I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Muhammad as my Messenger, and with Islam as my religion.

reference.en: Muslim 1/290. It is said right after the muezzin's testimony of faith (Ibn Khuzaymah 1/220)
reference.ar: مسلم 1/ 290. يقول ذلك عقب تشهد المؤذن (ابن خزيمة 1/ 220)

occasion-15-3.arabic: يُصَلِّي عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَعْدَ فَرَاغِهِ مِنَ إِجَابَةِ المُؤَذِّنِ
occasion-15-3.translation: He sends blessings upon the Prophet (peace be upon him) after he finishes responding to the muezzin.

reference.en: Muslim 1/288
reference.ar: مسلم 1/ 288

occasion-15-4.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلَاةِ القَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الوَسِيلَةَ وَالفَضِيلَةَ، وَأبْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، [إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ المِيعَادَ]
occasion-15-4.transliteration: Allāhumma rabba hādhihid-daʿwatit-tāmmah, waṣ-ṣalātil-qāʾimah, āti Muḥammadanil-wasīlata wal-faḍīlah, wabʿathhu maqāman maḥmūdanil-ladhī waʿadtah, innaka lā tukhliful-mīʿād.
occasion-15-4.translation: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and of the prayer about to be established, grant Muhammad the intercession and the excellence, and raise him to the praised station that You have promised him. [Indeed, You never break Your promise.]

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 1/152; the part in square brackets is from al-Bayhaqi 1/410, and al-'Allamah 'Abd al-'Aziz ibn Baz graded its chain good in Tuhfat al-Akhyar p. 38
reference.ar: البخاري 1/ 152 وما بين المعكوفين للبيهقي 1/ 410 وحسن إسناده العلامة عبد العزيز بن باز في تحفة الأخيار ص 38

occasion-15-5.arabic: يَدْعُو لِنَفْسِهِ بَيْنَ الأَذَانِ وَالإِقَامَةِ فَإِنَّ الدُّعَاءَ حِينَئِذٍ لَا يُرَدُّ
occasion-15-5.translation: He supplicates for himself between the call to prayer and the iqamah, for supplication at that time is not turned away.

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi, Abu Dawud and Ahmad; see also Irwa' al-Ghalil 1/262
reference.ar: التّرمذي وأبو داود وأحمد وانظر إرواء الغليل 1/ 262

occasion-16-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ المَشْرِقِ وَالمَغْرِبِ، اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ بِالمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالبَرَدِ
occasion-16-1.transliteration: Allāhumma bāʿid baynī wa bayna khaṭāyāya kamā bāʿadta baynal-mashriqi wal-maghrib. Allāhumma naqqinī min khaṭāyāya kamā yunaqqath-thawbul-abyaḍu minad-danas. Allāhummaghsilnī min khaṭāyāya bil-māʾi wath-thalji wal-barad.
occasion-16-1.translation: O Allah, put a distance between me and my sins as You have put a distance between the East and the West. O Allah, cleanse me of my sins as a white garment is cleansed of dirt. O Allah, wash away my sins with water, snow and hail.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 1/181; Muslim 1/419
reference.ar: البخاري 1/ 181 ومسلم 1/ 419

occasion-16-2.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكْ، وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
occasion-16-2.transliteration: Subḥānakallāhumma wa biḥamdik, wa tabārakasmuk, wa taʿālā jadduk, wa lā ilāha ghayruk.
occasion-16-2.translation: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise. Blessed is Your name, exalted is Your majesty, and there is no god but You.

reference.en: Reported by the authors of the four Sunan; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 1/77; Sahih Ibn Majah 1/135
reference.ar: أخرجه أصحاب السنن الأربعة وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 1/ 77 وصحيح ابن ماجه 1/ 135

occasion-16-3.arabic: وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ المُشْرِكِينَ، إِنَّ صَلَاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَايَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينْ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا مِنَ المُسْلِمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ المَلِكُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي، وَاعْتَرَفْتُ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي جَمِيعًا، إِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَاهْدِنِي لِأَحْسَنِ الأَخْلَاقِ، لَا يَهْدِي لِأَحْسَنِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا، لَا يَصْرِفُ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ، لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ، وَالخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ بِيَدَيْكَ، وَالشَّرُّ لَيْسَ إِلَيْكَ، أَنَا بِكَ وَإِلَيْكَ، تَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
occasion-16-3.transliteration: Wajjahtu wajhiya lilladhī faṭaras-samāwāti wal-arḍa ḥanīfan wa mā ana minal-mushrikīn. Inna ṣalātī wa nusukī wa maḥyāya wa mamātī lillāhi rabbil-ʿālamīn, lā sharīka lahu wa bidhālika umirtu wa ana minal-muslimīn. Allāhumma antal-maliku lā ilāha illā ant, anta rabbī wa ana ʿabduk, ẓalamtu nafsī waʿtaraftu bidhanbī, faghfir lī dhunūbī jamīʿā, innahu lā yaghfirudh-dhunūba illā ant. Wahdinī li-aḥsanil-akhlāq, lā yahdī li-aḥsanihā illā ant, waṣrif ʿannī sayyiʾahā, lā yaṣrifu ʿannī sayyiʾahā illā ant. Labbayka wa saʿdayk, wal-khayru kulluhu biyadayk, wash-sharru laysa ilayk, ana bika wa ilayk, tabārakta wa taʿālayt, astaghfiruka wa atūbu ilayk.
occasion-16-3.translation: I have turned my face towards the One who created the heavens and the earth, as a sincere monotheist, and I am not one of those who associate partners with Allah. My prayer, my sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds; He has no partner. This is what I have been commanded, and I am one of the Muslims (Al-An'am 6:79, 162-163). O Allah, You are the King; there is no god but You. You are my Lord and I am Your servant. I have wronged myself and I admit my sin, so forgive me all my sins, for none forgives sins but You. Guide me to the best of character, for none guides to the best of it but You, and turn its bad away from me, for none can turn its bad away from me but You. Here I am at Your service, and all goodness is in Your hands, and evil is not attributed to You. I exist by You and I return to You. Blessed and exalted are You. I seek Your forgiveness and I repent to You.

reference.en: Muslim 1/534
reference.ar: رواه مسلم 1/ 534

occasion-16-4.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَائِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ وَإِسْرَافِيلَ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ. اهْدِنِي لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الحَّقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ إِنَّكَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
occasion-16-4.transliteration: Allāhumma rabba Jibrāʾīla wa Mīkāʾīla wa Isrāfīl, fāṭiras-samāwāti wal-arḍ, ʿālimal-ghaybi wash-shahādah, anta taḥkumu bayna ʿibādika fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūn. Ihdinī limakhtulifa fīhi minal-ḥaqqi bi-idhnik, innaka tahdī man tashāʾu ilā ṣirāṭin mustaqīm.
occasion-16-4.translation: O Allah, Lord of Jibril, Mika'il and Israfil, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, You judge between Your servants in what they used to differ over. Guide me, by Your permission, to the truth in what has been differed over, for You guide whom You will to a straight path.

reference.en: Muslim 1/534
reference.ar: رواه مسلم 1/ 534

occasion-16-5.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا (ثَلَاثًا). أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ: مِنْ نَفْخِهِ، وَنَفْثِهِ، وَ هَمْزِهِ
occasion-16-5.transliteration: Allāhu akbaru kabīrā, Allāhu akbaru kabīrā, Allāhu akbaru kabīrā, wal-ḥamdu lillāhi kathīrā, wal-ḥamdu lillāhi kathīrā, wal-ḥamdu lillāhi kathīrā, wa subḥānallāhi bukratan wa aṣīlā. Aʿūdhu billāhi minash-shayṭānir-rajīm, min nafkhihi wa nafthihi wa hamzih.
occasion-16-5.translation: Allah is the Greatest, truly great; Allah is the Greatest, truly great; Allah is the Greatest, truly great. Praise be to Allah, abundantly; praise be to Allah, abundantly; praise be to Allah, abundantly. Glory be to Allah, morning and evening (three times). I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the accursed: from his puffing, his blowing and his prodding.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 1/203; Ibn Majah 1/265; Ahmad 4/85; Muslim reported something similar from Ibn Umar (may Allah be pleased with them both), with a story, 1/420
reference.ar: أخرجه أبو داود 1/ 203 وابن ماجه 1/ 265 وأحمد 4/ 85 وأخرجه مسلم عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما بنحوه وفيه قصة 1/ 420

occasion-16-6.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الحَمْدُ أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الحَمْدُ أَنْتَ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الحَمْدُ لَكَ مُلْكُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الحَمْدُ أَنْتَ مَلِكُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، وَلَكَ الحَمْدُ أَنْتَ الحَقُّ، وَوَعْدُكَ الحَقُّ، وَقَوْلُكَ الحَقُّ، وَلِقَاؤُكَ الحَقُّ، وَالجَنَّةُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّارُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّبِيُّونَ حَقٌّ، وَمُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَقٌّ وَالسَّاعَةُ حَقٌّ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ، وَبِكَ خَاصَمْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ حَاكَمْتُ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ، وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ أَنْتَ المُقَدِّمُ، وَأَنْتَ المُؤَخِّرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَنْتَ إِلَهِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
occasion-16-6.transliteration: Allāhumma lakal-ḥamdu anta nūrus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa man fīhinn, wa lakal-ḥamdu anta qayyimus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa man fīhinn, wa lakal-ḥamdu anta rabbus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa man fīhinn, wa lakal-ḥamdu laka mulkus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa man fīhinn, wa lakal-ḥamdu anta malikus-samāwāti wal-arḍ, wa lakal-ḥamdu antal-ḥaqq, wa waʿdukal-ḥaqq, wa qawlukal-ḥaqq, wa liqāʾukal-ḥaqq, wal-jannatu ḥaqq, wan-nāru ḥaqq, wan-nabiyyūna ḥaqq, wa Muḥammadun ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallama ḥaqq, was-sāʿatu ḥaqq. Allāhumma laka aslamt, wa ʿalayka tawakkalt, wa bika āmant, wa ilayka anabt, wa bika khāṣamt, wa ilayka ḥākamt, faghfir lī mā qaddamtu wa mā akhkhart, wa mā asrartu wa mā aʿlant, antal-muqaddimu wa antal-muʾakhkhir, lā ilāha illā ant, anta ilāhī lā ilāha illā ant.
occasion-16-6.translation: O Allah, to You belongs all praise; You are the Light of the heavens and the earth and all within them. To You belongs all praise; You are the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and all within them. To You belongs all praise; You are the Lord of the heavens and the earth and all within them. To You belongs all praise; Yours is the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all within them. To You belongs all praise; You are the King of the heavens and the earth. To You belongs all praise; You are the Truth, Your promise is true, Your word is true, the meeting with You is true, Paradise is true, the Fire is true, the prophets are true, Muhammad (peace be upon him) is true, and the Hour is true. O Allah, to You I have submitted, in You I have put my trust, in You I have believed, to You I have turned in repentance, by You I have argued, and to You I have brought my judgement. So forgive me what I have done before and what I have left for later, what I have kept secret and what I have done openly. You are the One who brings forward and the One who holds back; there is no god but You. You are my God; there is no god but You.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 3/3, 11/116, 13/371, 423, 465; Muslim, abridged and in similar wording, 1/532
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 3/ 3 و 11/ 116 و 13/ 371، 423، 465 ومسلم مختصرًا بنحوه 1/ 532

occasion-17-1.translation: Glory be to my Lord, the Most Great.

reference.en: Reported by the authors of the Sunan and Ahmad; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 1/83
reference.ar: أخرجه أهل السنن وأحمد وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 1/ 83

occasion-17-2.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
occasion-17-2.transliteration: Subḥānakallāhumma rabbanā wa biḥamdik, Allāhummaghfir lī.
occasion-17-2.translation: Glory be to You, O Allah, our Lord, and praise. O Allah, forgive me.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 1/199; Muslim 1/350
reference.ar: البخاري 1/ 199 ومسلم 1/ 350

occasion-17-3.translation: Perfect in glory, Most Holy, Lord of the angels and the Spirit.

reference.en: Muslim 1/353; Abu Dawud 1/230
reference.ar: مسلم 1/ 353 وأبو داود 1/ 230

occasion-17-4.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ رَكَعْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، خَشَعَ لَكَ سَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي وَمُخِّي وَعَظْمِي وَعَصَبِي، وَمَا اسْتَقَلَّ بِهِ قَدَمِي
occasion-17-4.transliteration: Allāhumma laka rakaʿt, wa bika āmant, wa laka aslamt, khashaʿa laka samʿī wa baṣarī wa mukhkhī wa ʿaẓmī wa ʿaṣabī, wa mastaqalla bihi qadamī.
occasion-17-4.translation: O Allah, to You I have bowed, in You I have believed, and to You I have submitted. My hearing, my sight, my mind, my bones, my sinews, and all that my feet carry are humbled before You.

reference.en: Muslim 1/534; and the four authors of the Sunan except Ibn Majah
reference.ar: مسلم 1/ 534 والأربعة إلا ابن ماجه

occasion-17-5.arabic: سُبْحَانَ ذِي الجَبَرُوتِ وَالمَلَكُوتِ وَالكِبْرِيَاءِ وَالعَظَمَةِ
occasion-17-5.translation: Glory be to the Possessor of might, dominion, grandeur and majesty.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 1/230; an-Nasa'i; Ahmad; its chain is good (hasan)
reference.ar: أبو داود 1/ 230 والنسائي وأحمد وإسناده حسن

occasion-18-1.translation: Allah hears the one who praises Him.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 2/282
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 2/ 282

occasion-18-2.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الحَمْدُ، حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ
occasion-18-2.transliteration: Rabbanā wa lakal-ḥamd, ḥamdan kathīran ṭayyiban mubārakan fīh.
occasion-18-2.translation: Our Lord, and to You belongs all praise: abundant, pure and blessed praise.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 2/284
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 2/ 284

occasion-18-3.arabic: مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا، وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ بَعْدُ. أَهْلَ الثَّنَاءِ وَالمَجْدِ، أَحَقُّ مَا قَالَ العَبْدُ، وَكُلُّنَا لَكَ عَبْدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الجَدِّ مِنْكَ الجَدُّ
occasion-18-3.transliteration: Milʾas-samāwāti wa milʾal-arḍi wa mā baynahumā, wa milʾa mā shiʾta min shayʾin baʿd. Ahlath-thanāʾi wal-majd, aḥaqqu mā qālal-ʿabd, wa kullunā laka ʿabd. Allāhumma lā māniʿa limā aʿṭayta wa lā muʿṭiya limā manaʿta wa lā yanfaʿu dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd.
occasion-18-3.translation: Praise filling the heavens, filling the earth and all that is between them, and filling whatever else You will. You are worthy of praise and glory, the truest thing a servant has said, and we are all Your servants: O Allah, none can withhold what You give, none can give what You withhold, and no one's wealth or standing can avail him against You.

reference.en: Muslim 1/346
reference.ar: مسلم 1/ 346

occasion-19-1.translation: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High.

reference.en: Reported by the authors of the Sunan and Ahmad; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 1/83
reference.ar: أخرجه أهل السنن وأحمد وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 1/ 83

occasion-19-2.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
occasion-19-2.transliteration: Subḥānakallāhumma rabbanā wa biḥamdik, Allāhummaghfir lī.
occasion-19-2.translation: Glory be to You, O Allah, our Lord, and praise. O Allah, forgive me.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari and Muslim; referenced earlier at number 34
reference.ar: البخاري ومسلم وتقدم تخريجه برقم 34

occasion-19-3.translation: Perfect in glory, Most Holy, Lord of the angels and the Spirit.

reference.en: Muslim 1/533; given earlier at number 35
reference.ar: مسلم 1/ 533 وتقدم برقم 35

occasion-19-4.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ سَجَدْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَصَوَّرَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ، وَبَصَرَهُ، تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الخَالِقِينَ
occasion-19-4.transliteration: Allāhumma laka sajadtu wa bika āmant, wa laka aslamt, sajada wajhiya lilladhī khalaqahu wa ṣawwarahu wa shaqqa samʿahu wa baṣarah, tabārakallāhu aḥsanul-khāliqīn.
occasion-19-4.translation: O Allah, to You I have prostrated, in You I have believed, and to You I have submitted. My face has prostrated to the One who created it and shaped it, and brought forth its hearing and its sight. Blessed is Allah, the best of creators (Al-Mu'minun 23:14).

reference.en: Muslim 1/534 and others
reference.ar: مسلم 1/ 534 وغيره

occasion-19-5.arabic: سُبْحَانَ ذِي الجَبَرُوتِ وَالمَلَكُوتِ، وَالكِبْرِيَاءِ وَالعَظَمَةِ
occasion-19-5.translation: Glory be to the Possessor of might, dominion, grandeur and majesty.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 1/230; Ahmad; an-Nasa'i; its chain is good (hasan)
reference.ar: أبو داود 1/ 230 وأحمد، والنسائي، وإسناده حسن

occasion-19-6.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ، دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلَانِيَّتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
occasion-19-6.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir lī dhanbī kullah, diqqahu wa jillah, wa awwalahu wa ākhirah, wa ʿalāniyatahu wa sirrah.
occasion-19-6.translation: O Allah, forgive me all my sins, the small and the great, the first and the last, the open and the secret.

reference.en: Muslim 1/350
reference.ar: مسلم 1/ 350

occasion-19-7.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لَا أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ
occasion-19-7.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu biriḍāka min sakhaṭik, wa bimuʿāfātika min ʿuqūbatik, wa aʿūdhu bika mink, lā uḥṣī thanāʾan ʿalayk, anta kamā athnayta ʿalā nafsik.
occasion-19-7.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your anger, and in Your pardon from Your punishment, and I seek refuge in You from You. I cannot count Your praises; You are as You have praised Yourself.

reference.en: Muslim 1/352
reference.ar: مسلم 1/ 352

occasion-20-1.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
occasion-20-1.translation: My Lord, forgive me. My Lord, forgive me.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 1/231; see also Sahih Ibn Majah 1/148
reference.ar: أبو داود 1/ 231 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجة 1/ 148

occasion-20-2.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَاجْبُرْنِي، وَعَافِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي، وَارْفَعْنِي
occasion-20-2.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir lī, warḥamnī, wahdinī, wajburnī, wa ʿāfinī, warzuqnī, warfaʿnī.
occasion-20-2.translation: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, mend me, keep me well, provide for me and raise me up.

reference.en: Reported by the authors of the Sunan except an-Nasa'i; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 1/90; Sahih Ibn Majah 1/148
reference.ar: أخرجه أصحاب السنن إلا النسائي وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 1/ 90 وصحيح ابن ماجه 1/ 148

occasion-21-1.arabic: سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ بِحَوْلِهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ {فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الخَالِقِينَ}
occasion-21-1.transliteration: Sajada wajhiya lilladhī khalaqahu wa shaqqa samʿahu wa baṣarahu biḥawlihi wa quwwatih, fatabārakallāhu aḥsanul-khāliqīn.
occasion-21-1.translation: My face has prostrated to the One who created it and brought forth its hearing and its sight by His might and His power. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators (Al-Mu'minun 23:14).

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi 2/474; Ahmad 6/30; al-Hakim 1/220, who graded it authentic, and adh-Dhahabi agreed, and the addition is his
reference.ar: التّرمذي 2/ 474 وأحمد 6/ 30 والحاكم وصححه ووافقه الذهبي 1/ 220 والزيادة له

occasion-21-2.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أُكْتُبْ لِي بِهَا عِنْدَكَ أَجْرًا، وَضَعْ عَنِّي بِهَا وِزْرًا، وَاجْعَلْهَا لِي عِنْدَكَ ذُخْرًا، وَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنِّي كَمَا تَقَبَّلْتَهَا مِنْ عَبْدِكَ دَاوُدْ
occasion-21-2.transliteration: Allāhummaktub lī bihā ʿindaka ajrā, wa ḍaʿ ʿannī bihā wizrā, wajʿalhā lī ʿindaka dhukhrā, wa taqabbalhā minnī kamā taqabbaltahā min ʿabdika Dāwūd.
occasion-21-2.translation: O Allah, record for me a reward for it with You, remove a burden of sin from me by it, store it up for me with You as a treasure, and accept it from me as You accepted it from Your servant Dawud.

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi 2/473; al-Hakim 1/219, who graded it authentic, and adh-Dhahabi agreed
reference.ar: التّرمذي 2/ 473 والحاكم وصححه ووافقه الذهبي 1/ 219

occasion-22-1.arabic: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ، وَالصَّلَوَاتُ، وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
occasion-22-1.transliteration: At-taḥiyyātu lillāh, waṣ-ṣalawāt, waṭ-ṭayyibāt, as-salāmu ʿalayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu wa raḥmatullāhi wa barakātuh, as-salāmu ʿalaynā wa ʿalā ʿibādillāhiṣ-ṣāliḥīn, ashhadu an lā ilāha illallāh, wa ashhadu anna Muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa rasūluh.
occasion-22-1.translation: All greetings are for Allah, and all prayers and all good things. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah. I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 1/13; Muslim 1/301
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 1/ 13 ومسلم 1/ 301

occasion-23-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
occasion-23-1.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammad, kamā ṣallayta ʿalā Ibrāhīma wa ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm, innaka ḥamīdun majīd. Allāhumma bārik ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammad, kamā bārakta ʿalā Ibrāhīma wa ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm, innaka ḥamīdun majīd.
occasion-23-1.translation: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 6/408
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 6/ 408

occasion-23-2.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَتِهِ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَتِهِ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
occasion-23-2.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā azwājihi wa dhurriyyatih, kamā ṣallayta ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm, wa bārik ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā azwājihi wa dhurriyyatihi kamā bārakta ʿalā āli Ibrāhīma innaka ḥamīdun majīd.
occasion-23-2.translation: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon his wives and his descendants, as You sent prayers upon the family of Ibrahim, and send blessings upon Muhammad and upon his wives and his descendants, as You sent blessings upon the family of Ibrahim; You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 6/407; Muslim 1/306, and the wording is his
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 6/ 407 ومسلم 1/ 306 واللفظ له

occasion-24-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ المَحْيَا وَالمَمَاتِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ المَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
occasion-24-1.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābil-qabr, wa min ʿadhābi jahannam, wa min fitnatil-maḥyā wal-mamāt, wa min sharri fitnatil-masīḥid-dajjāl.
occasion-24-1.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the punishment of Hell, from the trials of life and death, and from the evil of the trial of the False Messiah.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 2/102; Muslim 1/412, and the wording is Muslim's
reference.ar: البخاري 2/ 102 ومسلم 1/ 412 واللفظ لمسلم

occasion-24-2.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ المَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ المَحْيَا وَالمَمَاتِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ المَأْثَمِ وَالمَغْرَمِ
occasion-24-2.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābil-qabr, wa aʿūdhu bika min fitnatil-masīḥid-dajjāl, wa aʿūdhu bika min fitnatil-maḥyā wal-mamāt. Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika minal-maʾthami wal-maghram.
occasion-24-2.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, I seek refuge in You from the trial of the False Messiah, and I seek refuge in You from the trials of life and death. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from sin and from debt.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 1/202; Muslim 1/412
reference.ar: البخاري 1/ 202 ومسلم 1/ 412

occasion-24-3.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا، وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
occasion-24-3.transliteration: Allāhumma innī ẓalamtu nafsī ẓulman kathīrā, wa lā yaghfirudh-dhunūba illā ant, faghfir lī maghfiratan min ʿindik, warḥamnī innaka antal-ghafūrur-raḥīm.
occasion-24-3.translation: O Allah, I have greatly wronged myself, and none forgives sins but You, so grant me forgiveness from You and have mercy on me; You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 8/168; Muslim 4/2078
reference.ar: البخاري 8/ 168 ومسلم 4/ 2078

occasion-24-4.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ، وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ، وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ، وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي. أَنْتَ المُقَدِّمُ، وَأَنْتَ المُؤَخِّرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
occasion-24-4.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir lī mā qaddamt, wa mā akhkhart, wa mā asrart, wa mā aʿlant, wa mā asraft, wa mā anta aʿlamu bihi minnī. Antal-muqaddimu wa antal-muʾakhkhir, lā ilāha illā ant.
occasion-24-4.translation: O Allah, forgive me what I have done before and what I have left for later, what I have kept secret and what I have done openly, what I have done in excess, and what You know better than I do. You are the One who brings forward and the One who holds back; there is no god but You.

reference.en: Muslim 1/534
reference.ar: مسلم 1/ 534

occasion-24-5.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
occasion-24-5.transliteration: Allāhumma aʿinnī ʿalā dhikrik, wa shukrik, wa ḥusni ʿibādatik.
occasion-24-5.translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You well.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 2/86; an-Nasa'i 3/53; al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih Abi Dawud 1/284
reference.ar: أبو داود 2/ 86 والنسائي 3/ 53 وصححه الألباني في صحيح أبو داود 1/ 284

occasion-24-6.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ البُخْلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الجُبْنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أُرَدَّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ العُمُرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ القَبْرِ
occasion-24-6.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika minal-bukhli wa aʿūdhu bika minal-jubn, wa aʿūdhu bika min an uradda ilā ardhalil-ʿumur, wa aʿūdhu bika min fitnatid-dunyā wa ʿadhābil-qabr.
occasion-24-6.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from miserliness, and I seek refuge in You from cowardice, I seek refuge in You from being returned to the most feeble age, and I seek refuge in You from the trials of this world and the punishment of the grave.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 6/35
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 6/ 35

occasion-24-7.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
occasion-24-7.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾalukal-jannata wa aʿūdhu bika minan-nār.
occasion-24-7.translation: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and I seek refuge in You from the Fire.

reference.en: Abu Dawud; see also Sahih Ibn Majah 2/328
reference.ar: أبو داود وانظر صحيح ابن ماجه 2/ 328

occasion-24-8.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِعِلْمِكَ الغَيْبَ وَقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى الخَلْقِ أَحْيِنِي مَا عَلِمْتَ الحَيَاةَ خَيْرًا لِي وَتَوَفَّنِي إِذَا عَلِمْتَ الوَفَاةَ خَيْرًا لِي، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَشْيَتَكَ فِي الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ كَلِمَةَ الحَقِّ فِي الرِّضَا وَالغَضَبِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ القَصْدَ فِي الغِنَى وَالفَقْرِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ نَعِيمًا لَا يَنْفَدُ، وَأْسْأَلُكَ قُرَّةَ عَيْنٍ لَا تَنْقَطِعُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الرِّضَا بَعْدَ القَضَاءِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ بَرْدَ العَيْشِ بَعْدَ المَوْتِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ لَذَّةَ النَّظَرِ إِلَى وَجْهِكَ وَالشَّوْقَ إِلَى لِقَائِكَ فِي غَيْرِ ضَرَّاءَ مُضِرَّةٍ وَلَا فِتْنَةٍ مُضِلَّةٍ، اللَّهُمَّ زَيِّنَا بِزِينَةِ الإِيمَانِ، وَاجْعَلْنَا هُدَاةً مُهْتَدِينَ
occasion-24-8.transliteration: Allāhumma biʿilmikal-ghayba wa qudratika ʿalal-khalqi aḥyinī mā ʿalimtal-ḥayāta khayran lī wa tawaffanī idhā ʿalimtal-wafāta khayran lī. Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khashyataka fil-ghaybi wash-shahādah, wa asʾaluka kalimatal-ḥaqqi fir-riḍā wal-ghaḍab, wa asʾalukal-qaṣda fil-ghinā wal-faqr, wa asʾaluka naʿīman lā yanfad, wa asʾaluka qurrata ʿaynin lā tanqaṭiʿ, wa asʾalukar-riḍā baʿdal-qaḍāʾ, wa asʾaluka bardal-ʿayshi baʿdal-mawt, wa asʾaluka ladhdhatan-naẓari ilā wajhika wash-shawqa ilā liqāʾika fī ghayri ḍarrāʾa muḍirratin wa lā fitnatin muḍillah. Allāhumma zayyinnā bizīnatil-īmān, wajʿalnā hudātan muhtadīn.
occasion-24-8.translation: O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and Your power over creation, keep me alive as long as You know life is better for me, and take me when You know death is better for me. O Allah, I ask You for fear of You in private and in public. I ask You for the word of truth in contentment and in anger. I ask You for moderation in wealth and in poverty. I ask You for bliss that does not run out, and for a joy of the eye that does not end. I ask You for contentment after Your decree, and for a cool, pleasant life after death. I ask You for the delight of looking upon Your face and longing to meet You, without harmful affliction or misleading trial. O Allah, adorn us with the beauty of faith, and make us guides who are rightly guided.

reference.en: An-Nasa'i 4/54, 55; Ahmad 4/364; al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih an-Nasa'i 1/281
reference.ar: النسائي 4/ 54، 55 وأحمد 4/ 364 وصححه الألباني في صحيح النسائي 1/ 281

occasion-24-9.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ يَا اللَّهُ بِأَنَّكَ الوَاحِدُ الأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدْ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
occasion-24-9.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka yā Allāhu bi-annakal-wāḥidul-aḥaduṣ-ṣamad, alladhī lam yalid wa lam yūlad wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan aḥad, an taghfira lī dhunūbī, innaka antal-ghafūrur-raḥīm.
occasion-24-9.translation: O Allah, I ask You, O Allah, as You are the One, the Unique, the Self-Sufficient, who neither begets nor was begotten, and to whom no one is equal (Al-Ikhlas 112:3-4), that You forgive me my sins; You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.

reference.en: An-Nasa'i 3/52, in this wording; Ahmad 4/338; al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih an-Nasa'i 1/280
reference.ar: أخرجه النسائي بلفظه 3/ 52 وأحمد 4/ 338 وصححه الألباني في صحيح النسائي 1/ 280

occasion-24-10.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ الحَمْدَ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، المَنَّانُ، يَا بَدِيعَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ يَا ذَا الجَلَالِ وَالإِكْرَامِ، يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
occasion-24-10.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka bi-anna lakal-ḥamd, lā ilāha illā anta waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, al-mannān, yā badīʿas-samāwāti wal-arḍ, yā dhal-jalāli wal-ikrām, yā ḥayyu yā qayyūm, innī asʾalukal-jannata wa aʿūdhu bika minan-nār.
occasion-24-10.translation: O Allah, I ask You, as all praise is Yours; there is no god but You alone, without partner, the Bestower of favours. O Originator of the heavens and the earth, O Possessor of majesty and honour, O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all, I ask You for Paradise and I seek refuge in You from the Fire.

reference.en: Reported by the authors of the Sunan; see also Sahih Ibn Majah 2/329
reference.ar: رواه أهل السنن وانظر صحيح ابن ماجه 2/ 329

occasion-24-11.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، الأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدْ
occasion-24-11.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka bi-annī ashhadu annaka antallāhu lā ilāha illā ant, al-aḥaduṣ-ṣamad, alladhī lam yalid wa lam yūlad wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan aḥad.
occasion-24-11.translation: O Allah, I ask You, as I bear witness that You are Allah, there is no god but You, the Unique, the Self-Sufficient, who neither begets nor was begotten, and to whom no one is equal (Al-Ikhlas 112:2-4).

reference.en: Abu Dawud 2/62; at-Tirmidhi 5/515; Ibn Majah 2/1267; Ahmad 5/360; see also Sahih Ibn Majah 2/329; Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/163
reference.ar: أبو داود 2/ 62 والتّرمذي 5/ 515 وابن ماجه 2/ 1267 وأحمد 5/ 360 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجه 2/ 329 وصحيح التّرمذي 3/ 163

occasion-26-1.arabic: قَالَ جَابِرٌ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عِنْهُمَا : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يُعَلِّمُنَا الاسْتِخَارَةَ فِي الأُمُورِ كُلِّهَا كَمَا يُعَلِّمُنَا السُّورَةَ مِنَ القُرْآنِ، يَقُولُ : إِذَا هَمَّ أَحَدُكُمْ بِالأَمْرِ فَلْيَرْكَعْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ مِنْ غَيْرِ الفَرِيضَةِ، ثُمَّ لِيَقُلْ: (اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ العَظِيمِ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الغُيُوبِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأَمْرَ - وَيُسَمِّي حَاجَتَهُ - خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي - أَوْ قَالَ : عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ - فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي، ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي - أَوْ قَالَ : عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ - فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ، وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ، ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ)
occasion-26-1.transliteration: Allāhumma innī astakhīruka biʿilmik, wa astaqdiruka biqudratik, wa asʾaluka min faḍlikal-ʿaẓīm, fa-innaka taqdiru wa lā aqdir, wa taʿlamu wa lā aʿlam, wa anta ʿallāmul-ghuyūb. Allāhumma in kunta taʿlamu anna hādhal-amra khayrun lī fī dīnī wa maʿāshī wa ʿāqibati amrī, faqdurhu lī wa yassirhu lī, thumma bārik lī fīh. Wa in kunta taʿlamu anna hādhal-amra sharrun lī fī dīnī wa maʿāshī wa ʿāqibati amrī, faṣrifhu ʿannī waṣrifnī ʿanh, waqdur liyal-khayra ḥaythu kān, thumma arḍinī bih.
occasion-26-1.translation: Jabir ibn Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to teach us to seek Allah's guidance (istikhara) in all matters, just as he taught us a surah of the Qur'an. He would say: When one of you is concerned about a matter, let him pray two units of prayer other than the obligatory prayer, then say: (O Allah, I seek Your guidance through Your knowledge, I seek ability through Your power, and I ask You of Your great bounty, for You are able and I am not, You know and I do not, and You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know that this matter - and he names what he needs - is good for me in my religion, my livelihood and the outcome of my affairs - or he said: in my immediate and later affairs - then decree it for me, make it easy for me, and then bless me in it. And if You know that this matter is bad for me in my religion, my livelihood and the outcome of my affairs - or he said: in my immediate and later affairs - then turn it away from me and turn me away from it, decree for me what is good wherever it may be, and then make me content with it.)

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 7/162
reference.ar: البخاري 7/ 162

occasion-33-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ، وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ، وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلَا يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ، إِنَّهُ لَا يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَاَلَيْتَ، [وَلَا يَعِزُّ مَنْ عَادَيْتَ]، تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَتَعَالَيْتَ
occasion-33-1.transliteration: Allāhummahdinī fīman hadayt, wa ʿāfinī fīman ʿāfayt, wa tawallanī fīman tawallayt, wa bārik lī fīmā aʿṭayt, wa qinī sharra mā qaḍayt, fa-innaka taqḍī wa lā yuqḍā ʿalayk, innahu lā yadhillu man wālayt, wa lā yaʿizzu man ʿādayt, tabārakta rabbanā wa taʿālayt.
occasion-33-1.translation: O Allah, guide me among those You have guided, grant me well-being among those You have granted well-being, take me into Your care among those You have taken into Your care, bless me in what You have given, and protect me from the evil of what You have decreed. For You decree and none decrees over You. None whom You befriend is humbled, [and none whom You oppose is honoured]. Blessed are You, our Lord, and exalted.

reference.en: Reported by the authors of the four Sunan, Ahmad, ad-Darimi, al-Hakim and al-Bayhaqi; the words in square brackets are al-Bayhaqi's; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 1/144; Sahih Ibn Majah 1/194; Irwa al-Ghalil by al-Albani 2/172
reference.ar: أخرجه أصحاب السّنن الأربعة، وأحمد والدّارمي والحاكم والبيهقيّ، ومابين المعكوفين للبيهقي، وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 1/ 144 وصحيح ابن ماجة 1/ 194 وإرواء الغليل للألباني 2/ 172

occasion-33-2.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ، وأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لَا أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ، أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ
occasion-33-2.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu biriḍāka min sakhaṭik, wa bimuʿāfātika min ʿuqūbatik, wa aʿūdhu bika mink, lā uḥṣī thanāʾan ʿalayk, anta kamā athnayta ʿalā nafsik.
occasion-33-2.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your anger, and in Your pardon from Your punishment, and I seek refuge in You from You. I cannot count Your praises; You are as You have praised Yourself.

reference.en: Reported by the authors of the four Sunan and Ahmad; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/180; Sahih Ibn Majah 1/194; al-Irwa 2/175
reference.ar: أخرجه أصحاب السّنن الأربعة، وأحمد. انظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 180 وصحيح ابن ماجة 1/ 194، والإرواء 2/ 175

occasion-33-3.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ، وَلَكَ نُصَلِّي وَنَسْجُدُ، وَإِلَيْكَ نَسْعَى وَنَحْفِدُ، نَرْجُو رَحْمَتَكَ وَنَخْشَى عَذَابَكَ، إِنَّ عَذَابَكَ بِالكَافِرِينَ مُلْحَقٌ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْتَعِينُكَ، وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ، وَنُثْنِي عَلَيْكَ الخَيْرَ، وَلَا نَكْفُرُكَ، وَنُؤْمِنُ بِكَ، وَنَخْضَعُ لَكَ، وَنَخْلَعُ مَنْ يَكْفُرُكَ
occasion-33-3.transliteration: Allāhumma iyyāka naʿbud, wa laka nuṣallī wa nasjud, wa ilayka nasʿā wa naḥfid, narjū raḥmataka wa nakhshā ʿadhābak, inna ʿadhābaka bil-kāfirīna mulḥaq. Allāhumma innā nastaʿīnuk, wa nastaghfiruk, wa nuthnī ʿalaykal-khayr, wa lā nakfuruk, wa nuʾminu bik, wa nakhḍaʿu lak, wa nakhlaʿu man yakfuruk.
occasion-33-3.translation: O Allah, You alone we worship, to You we pray and prostrate, and towards You we strive and hasten. We hope for Your mercy and we fear Your punishment; Your punishment will surely overtake the disbelievers. O Allah, we seek Your help and Your forgiveness, we praise You with all good, we do not deny You, we believe in You, we humble ourselves before You, and we disown whoever disbelieves in You.

reference.en: Al-Bayhaqi in as-Sunan al-Kubra 2/211, who graded its chain authentic; Shaykh al-Albani said in Irwa al-Ghalil: this chain is authentic, 2/170. It is a saying of Umar (mawquf)
reference.ar: أخرجه البيهقيّ في السّنن الكبرى وصحح إسناده 2/ 211، وقال الشّيخ الألباني في إرواء الغليل: وهذا إسناده صحيح 2/ 170. وهو موقوف على عمر

occasion-34-1.arabic: سُبْحَانَ المَلِكِ القُدُّوسِ. وَالثَّالِثَةُ يَجْهَرُ بِهَا وَيَمُدُّ بِهَا صَوْتَهُ يَقُولُ: [رَبِّ المَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ]
occasion-34-1.translation: Glory be to the King, the Most Holy. The third time he says it aloud, drawing out his voice, saying: [Lord of the angels and the Spirit].

reference.en: An-Nasa'i 3/244, ad-Daraqutni and others; the words in square brackets are an addition of ad-Daraqutni 2/31, and its chain is authentic; see also Zad al-Ma'ad, edited by Shu'ayb al-Arna'ut and Abd al-Qadir al-Arna'ut, 1/337
reference.ar: رواه النّسائي 3/ 244 والدّاراقطني وغيرهما، وما بين المعكوفين زيادة للدّاراقطني 2/ 31 وإسناده صحيح. انظر زاد المعاد بتحقيق شعيب الأرناؤوط و عبد القادر الأرناؤوط 1/ 337

occasion-30-1.arabic: لَا إِلَهِ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الوَاحِدُ القَهَّارُ، رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا العَزِيزُ الغَفَّارُ
occasion-30-1.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhul-wāḥidul-qahhār, rabbus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa mā baynahumal-ʿazīzul-ghaffār.
occasion-30-1.translation: There is no god but Allah, the One, the Irresistible, Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Almighty, the Ever-Forgiving.

reference.en: He says this when turning from one side to the other. Al-Hakim 1/540, who graded it authentic, and adh-Dhahabi agreed; an-Nasa'i in Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah; Ibn as-Sunni; see also Sahih al-Jami 4/213
reference.ar: يقول ذلك إذا تقلّب من جنب إلى جنب. أخرجه الحاكم وصححه ووافقه الذّهبي 1/ 540 والنّسائي في عمل اليوم والّيلة، وابن السّني، وانظر صحيح الجامع 4/ 213

occasion-31-1.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
occasion-31-1.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bikalimātillāhit-tāmmāti min ghaḍabihi wa ʿiqābih, wa sharri ʿibādih, wa min hamazātish-shayāṭīni wa an yaḥḍurūn.
occasion-31-1.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and His punishment, from the evil of His servants, and from the promptings of the devils and from their coming near me.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 4/12; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/171
reference.ar: أبو داود 4/ 12 وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 171

occasion-32-1.translation: He spits lightly to his left.

reference.en: Muslim 4/1772
reference.ar: مسلم 4/ 1772

occasion-32-2.arabic: يَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا رَأَى
occasion-32-2.translation: He seeks refuge in Allah from Satan and from the evil of what he saw.

occasion-32-3.translation: He does not tell anyone about it.

reference.en: Muslim 4/1772
reference.ar: مسلم 4/ 1772

occasion-32-4.arabic: يَتَحَوَّلَ عَنْ جَنْبِهِ الذِي كَانَ عَلَيْهِ
occasion-32-4.translation: He turns over from the side he was lying on.

reference.en: Muslim 4/1773
reference.ar: مسلم 4/ 1773

occasion-32-5.translation: He gets up and prays, if he wishes.

reference.en: Muslim 4/1773
reference.ar: مسلم 4/ 1773

occasion-35-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، اِبْنُ عَبْدِكَ، اِبْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اِسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ، سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوْ اِسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ القُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلَاءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
occasion-35-1.transliteration: Allāhumma innī ʿabduk, ibnu ʿabdik, ibnu amatik, nāṣiyatī biyadik, māḍin fiyya ḥukmuk, ʿadlun fiyya qaḍāʾuk, asʾaluka bikullismin huwa lak, sammayta bihi nafsak, aw anzaltahu fī kitābik, aw ʿallamtahu aḥadan min khalqik, awistaʾtharta bihi fī ʿilmil-ghaybi ʿindak, an tajʿalal-qurʾāna rabīʿa qalbī, wa nūra ṣadrī, wa jalāʾa ḥuznī, wa dhahāba hammī.
occasion-35-1.translation: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant. My forelock is in Your hand, Your judgement upon me is done, and Your decree concerning me is just. I ask You by every name that is Yours, with which You have named Yourself, or sent down in Your Book, or taught to any of Your creation, or kept to Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen with You, that You make the Qur'an the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the departure of my sorrow and the end of my worry.

reference.en: Ahmad 1/391; al-Albani graded it authentic
reference.ar: أحمد 1/ 391 وصحّحه الألبانيّ

occasion-35-2.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الهَمِّ وَالحَزَنِ، وَالعَجْزِ وَالكَسَلِ، وَالبُخْلِ وَالجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
occasion-35-2.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika minal-hammi wal-ḥazan, wal-ʿajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa ḍalaʿid-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijāl.
occasion-35-2.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from helplessness and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, and from the burden of debt and being overpowered by men.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 7/158; the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to say this supplication often; see also Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 11/173
reference.ar: البخاري 7/ 158، كان رسول اللّه صلّى اللّه عليه وسلّم يُكثِر من هذا الدّعاء. انظر البخاري مع الفتح 11/ 173

occasion-36-1.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ العَظِيمُ الحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ العَرْشِ العَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ العَرْشِ الكَرِيمِ
occasion-36-1.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhul-ʿaẓīmul-ḥalīm, lā ilāha illallāhu rabbul-ʿarshil-ʿaẓīm, lā ilāha illallāhu rabbus-samāwāti wa rabbul-arḍi wa rabbul-ʿarshil-karīm.
occasion-36-1.translation: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth and Lord of the Noble Throne.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 7/154; Muslim 4/2092
reference.ar: البخاري 7/ 154 ومسلم 4/ 2092

occasion-36-2.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لَاإِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
occasion-36-2.transliteration: Allāhumma raḥmataka arjū fa lā takilnī ilā nafsī ṭarfata ʿayn, wa aṣliḥ lī shaʾnī kullah, lā ilāha illā ant.
occasion-36-2.translation: O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for, so do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye, and set right all my affairs. There is none worthy of worship but You.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 4/324; Ahmad 5/42; graded good by al-Albani in Sahih Abi Dawud 3/959
reference.ar: أبو داود 4/ 324 وأحمد 5/ 42 وحسّنه الألبانيّ في صحيح أبي داود 3/ 959

occasion-36-3.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
occasion-36-3.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu minaẓ-ẓālimīn.
occasion-36-3.translation: There is none worthy of worship but You. Glory be to You; truly I have been among the wrongdoers (Al-Anbiya 21:87).

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi 5/529; al-Hakim, who graded it authentic, and adh-Dhahabi agreed 1/505; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/168
reference.ar: التّرمذي 5/ 529، والحاكم، وصحّحه ووافقه الذّهبيّ 1/ 505، وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 168

occasion-36-4.arabic: اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا
occasion-36-4.transliteration: Allāhu Allāhu rabbī lā ushriku bihi shayʾā.
occasion-36-4.translation: Allah, Allah is my Lord; I do not associate anything with Him.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 2/87; see also Sahih Ibn Majah 2/335
reference.ar: أخرجه أبو داود 2/ 87 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجة 2/ 335

occasion-37-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِمُ، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمُ
occasion-37-1.transliteration: Allāhumma innā najʿaluka fī nuḥūrihim, wa naʿūdhu bika min shurūrihim.
occasion-37-1.translation: O Allah, we place You before them, and we seek refuge in You from their evil.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 2/89; al-Hakim graded it authentic, and adh-Dhahabi agreed 2/142
reference.ar: أبو داود 2/ 89، وصحّحه الحاكم ووافقه الذّهبيّ 2/ 142

occasion-37-2.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي، وَأَنْتَ نَصِيرِي، بِكَ أَجُولُ، وَبِكَ أَصُولُ، وَبِكَ أُقَاتِلُ
occasion-37-2.transliteration: Allāhumma anta ʿaḍudī, wa anta naṣīrī, bika ajūl, wa bika aṣūl, wa bika uqātil.
occasion-37-2.translation: O Allah, You are my support and You are my helper. By You I move, by You I attack, and by You I fight.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 3/42; at-Tirmidhi 5/572; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/183
reference.ar: أبو داود 3/ 42 والتّرمذي 5/ 572، وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 183

occasion-37-3.translation: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs (Al Imran 3:173).

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 5/172
reference.ar: البخاري 5/ 172

occasion-38-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ، وَرَبَّ العَرْشِ العَظِيمِ، كُنْ لِي جَارًا مِنْ فُلَانٍ بْنِ فُلَانٍ، وَأَحْزَابِهِ مِنْ خَلَائِقِكَ، أَنْ يَفْرُطَ عَلَيَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَوْ يَطْغَى، عَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
occasion-38-1.transliteration: Allāhumma rabbas-samāwātis-sabʿ, wa rabbal-ʿarshil-ʿaẓīm, kun lī jāran min fulānibni fulān, wa aḥzābihi min khalāʾiqik, an yafruṭa ʿalayya aḥadun minhum aw yaṭghā, ʿazza jāruk, wa jalla thanāʾuk, wa lā ilāha illā ant.
occasion-38-1.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Mighty Throne, be my protector against so-and-so son of so-and-so and his allies among Your creation, lest any of them act hastily against me or transgress. Mighty is the one You protect, exalted is Your praise, and there is none worthy of worship but You.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-Mufrad no. 707; graded authentic by al-Albani in Sahih al-Adab al-Mufrad no. 545
reference.ar: البخاري في الأدب المفرد برقم 707 وصحّحه الألبانيّ في صحيح الأدب المفرد برقم 545

occasion-38-2.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ جَمِيعًا، اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِمَّا أَخَافُ وَأَحْذَرُ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ، المُمْسِكِ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ أَنْ يَقَعْنَ عَلَى الأَرْضِ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ، مِنْ شَرِّ عَبْدِكَ فُلَانٍ، وَجُنُودِهِ وَأَتْبَاعِهِ وَأَشْيَاعِهِ، مِنَّ الجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ، اللَّهُمَّ كُنْ لِي جَارًا مِنْ شَرِّهِمْ، جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَعَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اِسْمُكَ، وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
occasion-38-2.transliteration: Allāhu akbar, Allāhu aʿazzu min khalqihi jamīʿā, Allāhu aʿazzu mimmā akhāfu wa aḥdhar, aʿūdhu billāhil-ladhī lā ilāha illā huwal-mumsikis-samāwātis-sabʿi an yaqaʿna ʿalal-arḍi illā biʾidhnih, min sharri ʿabdika fulān, wa junūdihi wa atbāʿihi wa ashyāʿih, minal-jinni wal-ins. Allāhumma kun lī jāran min sharrihim, jalla thanāʾuka wa ʿazza jāruk, wa tabārakasmuk, wa lā ilāha ghayruk.
occasion-38-2.translation: Allah is the Greatest. Allah is mightier than all His creation. Allah is mightier than what I fear and dread. I seek refuge in Allah, besides whom there is none worthy of worship, who holds back the seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by His permission, from the evil of Your servant so-and-so, and his soldiers, followers and supporters, from among the jinn and mankind. O Allah, be my protector against their evil. Exalted is Your praise, mighty is the one You protect, blessed is Your name, and there is none worthy of worship besides You.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-Mufrad no. 708; graded authentic by al-Albani in Sahih al-Adab al-Mufrad no. 546
reference.ar: البخاري في الأدب المفرد برقم 708 وصحّحه الألباني في صحيح الأدب المفرد برقم 546

occasion-39-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الكِتَابِ، سَرِيعَ الحِسَابِ، اِهْزِمْ الأَحْزَابَ، اللَّهُمَّ اِهْزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ
occasion-39-1.transliteration: Allāhumma munzilal-kitāb, sarīʿal-ḥisāb, ihzimil-aḥzāb, Allāhummahzimhum wa zalzilhum.
occasion-39-1.translation: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift in reckoning, defeat the confederates. O Allah, defeat them and shake them.

reference.en: Muslim 3/1362
reference.ar: مسلم 3/ 1362

occasion-40-1.translation: O Allah, protect me from them with whatever You will.

reference.en: Muslim 4/2300
reference.ar: مسلم 4/ 2300

occasion-41-1.translation: He should seek refuge in Allah.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 6/336; Muslim 1/120
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 6/ 336 ومسلم 1/ 120

occasion-41-2.translation: He should stop dwelling on what he has doubts about.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 6/336; Muslim 1/120
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 6/ 336 ومسلم 1/ 120

occasion-41-3.translation: He should say: I believe in Allah and His messengers.

reference.en: Muslim 1/119-120

occasion-41-4.arabic: يَقْرَأُ قَوْلَهُ تَعَالَى: {هُوَ الْأَوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ}
occasion-41-4.transliteration: Huwal-awwalu wal-ākhiru waẓ-ẓāhiru wal-bāṭinu wa huwa bikulli shayʾin ʿalīm.
occasion-41-4.translation: He should recite the words of Allah the Exalted: He is the First and the Last, the Manifest and the Hidden, and He has full knowledge of all things (Al-Hadid 57:3).

reference.en: Surat al-Hadid, verse 3; Abu Dawud 4/329, graded good by al-Albani in Sahih Abi Dawud 3/962
reference.ar: سورة الحديد، الآية: 3. أبو داود 4/ 329 وحسّنه الألبانيّ في صحيح أبي داود 3/ 962

occasion-42-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اِكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
occasion-42-1.transliteration: Allāhummakfinī biḥalālika ʿan ḥarāmik, wa aghninī bifaḍlika ʿamman siwāk.
occasion-42-1.translation: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful so that I have no need of what You have forbidden, and by Your bounty make me free of need of anyone besides You.

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi 5/560; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/180
reference.ar: التّرمذي 5/ 560 وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 180

occasion-42-2.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الهَمِّ وَالحَزَنِ، وَالعَجْزِ وَالكَسَلِ، وَالبُخْلِ وَالجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
occasion-42-2.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika minal-hammi wal-ḥazan, wal-ʿajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa ḍalaʿid-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijāl.
occasion-42-2.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, and from the burden of debt and being overpowered by men.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 7/158
reference.ar: البخاري 7/ 158

occasion-43-1.arabic: يَقُولُ: (أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ)، وَيَتْفُلْ عَلَى يَسَارِهِ
occasion-43-1.translation: He should say: (I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the accursed), and spit lightly to his left.

reference.en: Muslim 4/1729, from the hadith of Uthman ibn Abi al-As (may Allah be pleased with him), in which he says: So I did that, and Allah removed it from me
reference.ar: مسلم 4/ 1729 من حديث عثمان بن أبي العاص رضي اللّه عنه، وفيه: ففعلت ذلك فأذهبه اللّه عنّي

occasion-44-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
occasion-44-1.transliteration: Allāhumma lā sahla illā mā jaʿaltahu sahlā, wa anta tajʿalul-ḥazna idhā shiʾta sahlā.
occasion-44-1.translation: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy, and You make the difficult easy if You will.

reference.en: Ibn Hibban in his Sahih no. 2427 (Mawarid); Ibn as-Sunni no. 351; al-Hafiz said: this is an authentic hadith; graded authentic by Abd al-Qadir al-Arnaut in his checking of al-Adhkar by an-Nawawi p. 106
reference.ar: رواه ابن حبان في صحيحه برقم 2427 (موارد) وابن السّنّي برقم 351 وقال الحافظ: هذا حديث صحيح، وصحّحه عبدالقادر الأرناؤوط في تخريج الأذكار للنّووي ص 106

occasion-46-1.translation: Seeking refuge in Allah from him.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 1/206; at-Tirmidhi; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 1/77; see also Surat al-Muminun, verses 98-99
reference.ar: أبو داود 1/ 206، والتّرمذي، وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 1/ 77، وانظر سورة المؤمنون آية 98 - 99

reference.en: Muslim 1/291; al-Bukhari 1/151
reference.ar: مسلم 1/ 291 والبخاري 1/ 151

occasion-46-3.translation: The remembrances of Allah and reciting the Quran.
