reference.en: "Do not make your houses into graves; Satan flees from the house in which Surat al-Baqarah is recited." Reported by Muslim 1/539. Among what drives Satan away are the morning and evening remembrances, those for sleeping and waking, and the other prescribed remembrances, such as reciting Ayat al-Kursi at bedtime and the last two verses of Surat al-Baqarah. Whoever says "There is none worthy of worship but Allah alone, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is able to do all things" one hundred times, it is a protection for him from Satan for that whole day. Likewise the call to prayer drives Satan away
reference.ar: {لاتجعلوا بيوتكم مقابر، إنّ الشّيطان ينفر من البيت الذي تقرأ فيه سورة البقرة} رواه مسلم 1/ 539. ومما يطرد الشّيطان أذكار الصّباح والمساء، والنّوم والاستيقاظ، وغير ذلك من الأذكار المشروعة مثل قراءة آية الكرسيّ عند النّوم، والآيتين الأخيرتين من سورة البقرة، ومن قال: لا إله إلّا اللّه وحده لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شيء قدير مائة مرة كانت له حِرْزًا من الشّيطان يومه كلّه. وكذا الأذان يطرد الشّيطان

occasion-47-1.translation: It is the decree of Allah, and He does what He wills.

reference.en: "The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, and there is good in both. Strive for what benefits you, seek the help of Allah and do not give up. If something befalls you, do not say: If only I had done such and such, but say: It is the decree of Allah, and He does what He wills; for 'if only' opens the door to the work of Satan." Muslim 4/2052
reference.ar: {المؤمن القويّ خير وأحبّ إلى اللّه من المؤمن الضعيف وفي كلّ خير، احرص على ما ينفعك واستعن باللّه ولا تعجز، وإن أصابك شيء فلا تقل لو أنّي فعلت كذا وكذا، ولكن قل: قَدَرُ اللّه. وما شاء فعل، فإنّ لو تفتح عمل الشّيطان} مسلم 4/ 2052

occasion-54-1.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
occasion-54-1.transliteration: Innā lillāhi wa innā ilayhi rājiʿūn, Allāhummaʾjurnī fī muṣībatī wa akhlif lī khayran minhā.
occasion-54-1.translation: Truly we belong to Allah and truly to Him we shall return (Al-Baqarah 2:156). O Allah, reward me in my affliction and replace it for me with something better.

reference.en: Muslim 2/632
reference.ar: مسلم 2/ 632

occasion-83-1.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed devil.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 7/99; Muslim 4/2015
reference.ar: البخاري 7/ 99 ومسلم 4/ 2015

occasion-93-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا أَعْلَمُ
occasion-93-1.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika an ushrika bika wa ana aʿlam, wa astaghfiruka limā lā aʿlam.
occasion-93-1.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from associating anything with You knowingly, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do not know.

reference.en: Ahmad 4/403 and others; see also Sahih al-Jami 3/233 and al-Albani's Sahih at-Targhib wat-Tarhib 1/19
reference.ar: أحمد 4/ 403 وغيره وانظر صحيح الجامع 3/ 233 وصحيح التّرغيب والتّرهيب للألباني 1/ 19

occasion-127-1.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 6/181; Muslim 4/2208
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 6/ 181، ومسلم 4/ 2208

occasion-129-1.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ التِي لَا يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلَا فَاجِرٌ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَبَرَأَ وَذَرَأَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ فِي الأَرْضِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتَنِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ إِلَّا طَارِقًا يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرً يَا رَحْمَانُ
occasion-129-1.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bikalimātillāhit-tāmmātil-latī lā yujāwizuhunna barrun wa lā fājirun min sharri mā khalaqa wa baraʾa wa dharaʾ, wa min sharri mā yanzilu minas-samāʾ, wa min sharri mā yaʿruju fīhā, wa min sharri mā dharaʾa fil-arḍ, wa min sharri mā yakhruju minhā, wa min sharri fitanil-layli wan-nahār, wa min sharri kulli ṭāriqin illā ṭāriqan yaṭruqu bikhayrin yā raḥmān.
occasion-129-1.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah, which neither the righteous nor the wicked can go beyond, from the evil of what He has created, brought into being and scattered; from the evil of what comes down from the sky and the evil of what rises up into it; from the evil of what He has scattered in the earth and the evil of what comes out of it; from the evil of the trials of the night and the day; and from the evil of every visitor by night, except a visitor who comes with good, O Most Merciful.

reference.en: Ahmad 3/419 with an authentic chain; Ibn as-Sunni no. 637; al-Arna'ut graded its chain authentic in his checking of at-Tahawiyyah p. 133; see also Majma' az-Zawa'id 10/127
reference.ar: أحمد 3/ 419 بإسناد صحيح وابن السّني برقم 637 وصحّح إسناده الأرناؤوط في تخريجه للطّحاوية ص 133 وانظر مجمع الزوائد 10/ 127

occasion-45-1.arabic: مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يُذْنِبُ ذَنْبًا فَيُحْسِنُ الطُّهُورَ، ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ إِلَّا غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ
occasion-45-1.translation: There is no servant who commits a sin, then purifies himself well, then stands and prays two units of prayer, then asks Allah for forgiveness, except that Allah forgives him.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 2/86; at-Tirmidhi 2/257; graded authentic by al-Albani in Sahih Abi Dawud 1/283
reference.ar: أبو داود 2/ 86 والتّرمذي 2/ 257 وصحّحه الألبانيّ في صحيح أبي داود 1/ 283

occasion-85-1.arabic: عَنِ اِبْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: كَانَ يُعَدُّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي المَجْلِسِ الوَاحِدِ مِائَةُ مَرَّةٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَقُومَ: (رَبِّ اِغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الغَفُورُ)
occasion-85-1.transliteration: Rabbighfir lī wa tub ʿalayya innaka antat-tawwābul-ghafūr.
occasion-85-1.translation: Ibn Umar said: It used to be counted that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) would say one hundred times in a single gathering before he stood up: "My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance, for You are the Accepter of Repentance, the Most Forgiving."

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi and others; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/153 and Sahih Ibn Majah 2/321; the wording is at-Tirmidhi's
reference.ar: التّرمذي وغيره وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 153 وصحيح ابن ماجة 2/ 321 ولفظه للتّرمذي

occasion-86-1.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
occasion-86-1.transliteration: Subḥānakallāhumma wa biḥamdik, ashhadu an lā ilāha illā ant, astaghfiruka wa atūbu ilayk.
occasion-86-1.translation: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You. I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.

reference.en: Reported by the compilers of the Sunan; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/153. It is established that Aishah (may Allah be pleased with her) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) never sat in a gathering, recited the Quran or prayed a prayer without ending it with these words: '...'. An-Nasa'i in Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah no. 308; Ahmad 6/77; graded authentic by Dr Faruq Hamadah in his edition of an-Nasa'i's Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah, p. 273
reference.ar: أخرجه أصحاب السّنن وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 153، وقد ثبت أنّ عائشة رضي اللّه عنها قالت: ما جلس رسول اللّه صلّى اللّه عليه وسلّم مجلسا، ولا تلى قرآنا، ولا صلّى صلاة إلّا ختم ذلك بكلمات: '...'، أخرجه النّسائي في عمل اليوم واللّيلة برقم 308، وأحمد 6/ 77 وصحّحه الدّكتور فاروق حمادة في تحقيقه لعمل اليوم واللّيلة للنّسائي ص 273

occasion-89-1.arabic: مَنْ حَفِظَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ أَوَّلِ سُورَةِ الكَهْفِ عُصِمَ مِنَ الدَّجَّالِ
occasion-89-1.translation: Whoever memorises ten verses from the beginning of Surat al-Kahf will be protected from the Dajjal.

reference.en: Muslim 1/555; in another narration, from the end of al-Kahf, 1/556
reference.ar: مسلم 1/ 555، وفي رواية من آخر الكهف 1/ 556

occasion-89-2.arabic: وَالاِسْتِعَاذَةُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ فِتْنَتِهِ عَقِبَ التَّشَهُّدِ الأَخِيرِ مِنْ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ
occasion-89-2.translation: And seeking refuge in Allah from his trial after the final tashahhud of every prayer.

reference.en: See hadith no. 55 and hadith no. 56 of this book
reference.ar: انظر حديث رقم 55 وحديث رقم 56 من هذا الكتاب

occasion-130-1.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لَأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ فِي اليَوْمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةٍ)
occasion-130-1.translation: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: 'By Allah, I seek Allah's forgiveness and repent to Him more than seventy times a day.'

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 11/101
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 11/ 101

occasion-130-2.arabic: وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَإِنِّي أَتُوبُ فِي اليَوْمِ إِلَيْهِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ)
occasion-130-2.translation: And he (peace be upon him) said: 'O people, repent to Allah, for I repent to Him a hundred times a day.'

reference.en: Muslim 4/2076
reference.ar: مسلم 4/ 2076

occasion-130-3.arabic: وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (مَنْ قَالَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ العَظِيمَ الذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الحَيُّ القَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ، غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ فَرَّ مِنَ الزَّحْفِ)
occasion-130-3.transliteration: Astaghfirullāhal-ʿaẓīmal-ladhī lā ilāha illā huwal-ḥayyul-qayyūmu wa atūbu ilayh.
occasion-130-3.translation: And he (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever says: I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Almighty, besides whom none has the right to be worshipped, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all, and I repent to Him, Allah will forgive him, even if he fled from the battlefield.'

reference.en: Abu Dawud 2/85; at-Tirmidhi 5/569; al-Hakim 1/511, who graded it authentic, and adh-Dhahabi agreed; graded authentic by al-Albani; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/182 and Jami' al-Usul li-Ahadith ar-Rasul (peace be upon him) 4/389-390, edited by al-Arna'ut
reference.ar: أخرجه أبو داود 2/ 85 والتّرمذي 5/ 569 والحاكم وصحّحه ووافقه الذّهبي 1/ 511 وصحّحه الألباني. انظر صحيح الترمذي 3/ 182 وجامع الأصول لأحاديث الرسول صلّى اللّه عليه وسلّم 4/ 389 - 390 بتحقيق الأرناؤوط

occasion-130-4.arabic: وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الرَّبُّ مِنَ العَبْدِ فِي جَوْفِ اللَّيْلِ الآخِرِ، فَإِنْ اِسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِمَّنْ يَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ فِي تِلْكَ السَّاعَةِ فَكُنْ)
occasion-130-4.translation: And he (peace be upon him) said: 'The Lord is nearest to the servant in the last part of the night, so if you are able to be among those who remember Allah at that hour, then be so.'

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi; an-Nasa'i 1/279; al-Hakim; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/183 and Jami' al-Usul, edited by al-Arna'ut, 4/144
reference.ar: أخرجه الترمذي والنسائي 1/ 279، والحاكم وانظر صحيح الترمذي 3/ 183 وجامع الأصول بتحقيق الأرناؤوط 4/ 144

occasion-130-5.arabic: وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ العَبْدُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَهُوَ سَاجِدٌ فَأَكْثِرُوا الدُّعَاءَ)
occasion-130-5.translation: And he (peace be upon him) said: 'The servant is nearest to his Lord while he is prostrating, so supplicate much.'

reference.en: Muslim 1/350
reference.ar: مسلم 1/ 350

occasion-130-6.arabic: وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (إِنَّهُ لَيُغَانُ عَلَى قَلْبِي وَإِنِّي لَأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ فِي اليَوْمِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ)
occasion-130-6.translation: And he (peace be upon him) said: 'A covering comes over my heart, and I seek Allah's forgiveness a hundred times a day.'

reference.en: Muslim 4/2075. Ibn al-Athir said: 'a covering comes over my heart' means it is covered and veiled, and what is meant is lapses of attention; for he (peace be upon him) was always increasing in remembrance, nearness and constant watchfulness, so if at times he became inattentive to any of it, or forgot, he counted it a sin against himself and hastened to seek forgiveness. See also Jami' al-Usul 4/386
reference.ar: أخرجه مسلم 4/ 2075 قال ابن الأثير: (ليغان على قلبي) أي ليغطى ويغشى والمراد به: السهو؛ لأنه كان صلّى اللّه عليه وسلّم لا يزال في مزيد من الذكر والقربة ودوام المراقبة فإذا سها عن شيء منها في بعض الأوقات، أو نسي، عدّه ذنبا على نفسه ففزع إلى الاستغفار. انظر جامع الأصول 4/ 386

occasion-50-1.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ، طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
occasion-50-1.translation: No harm; it is a purification, if Allah wills.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 10/118
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 10/ 118

occasion-50-2.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ العَظِيمَ رَبَّ العَرْشِ العَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
occasion-50-2.translation: I ask Allah the Mighty, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to cure you.

reference.en: There is no Muslim servant who visits a sick person whose appointed time has not come and says this seven times, except that the sick person is cured. Reported by at-Tirmidhi and Abu Dawud; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 2/210; Sahih al-Jami 5/180
reference.ar: ما من عبد مسلم يعود مريضا لم يحضر أجله فيقول سبع مرّات الحيدث إلّا عوفيَ. أخرجه التّرمذي وأبو داود وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 2/ 210 وصحيح الجامع 5/ 180

occasion-52-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اِغْفِرْ لِي وَاِرْحَمْنِي وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ الأَعْلَى
occasion-52-1.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir lī warḥamnī wa alḥiqnī bir-rafīqil-aʿlā.
occasion-52-1.translation: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, and join me with the highest companions.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 7/10; Muslim 4/1893
reference.ar: البخاري 7/ 10 ومسلم 4/ 1893

occasion-52-2.arabic: جَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ يُدْخِلُ يَدَيْهِ فِي المَاءِ فَيَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا وَجْهَهُ وَيَقُولُ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ إِنَّ لِلْمَوْتِ لَسَكَرَاتٌ
occasion-52-2.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāh, inna lil-mawti lasakarāt.
occasion-52-2.translation: As death came to him, the Prophet (peace be upon him) began putting his hands into water and wiping his face with them, saying: There is none worthy of worship but Allah; truly death has its agonies.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 8/144; the hadith also mentions the siwak (tooth-stick)
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 8/ 144 وفي الحديث السّواك

occasion-52-3.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، لَاإِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
occasion-52-3.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu wallāhu akbar, lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdah, lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lā ilāha illallāhu lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamd, lā ilāha illallāhu wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh.
occasion-52-3.translation: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest. There is none worthy of worship but Allah alone. There is none worthy of worship but Allah alone, without partner. There is none worthy of worship but Allah; His is the dominion and His is the praise. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi and Ibn Majah, graded authentic by al-Albani; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/152; Sahih Ibn Majah 2/317
reference.ar: أخرجه التّرمذي وابن ماجة وصحّحه الألبانيّ، انظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 152 وصحيح ابن ماجة 2/ 317

occasion-53-1.arabic: مَنْ كَانَ آخِرُ كَلَامِهِ (لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ) دَخَلَ الجَنَّةَ
occasion-53-1.translation: Whoever's last words are (There is none worthy of worship but Allah) will enter Paradise.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 3/190; see also Sahih al-Jami 5/342
reference.ar: أبو داود 3/ 190 وانظر صحيح الجامع 5/ 342

occasion-55-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اِغْفِرْ لِفُلَانٍ - بِاِسْمِهِ - وَاِرْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي المَهْدِيِّينَ، وَاخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الغَابِرِينَ، وَاِغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ يَا رَبَّ العَالَمِينَ، وَاِفْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ
occasion-55-1.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir lifulān, warfaʿ darajatahu fil-mahdiyyīn, wakhlufhu fī ʿaqibihi fil-ghābirīn, waghfir lanā wa lahu yā rabbal-ʿālamīn, wafsaḥ lahu fī qabrihi wa nawwir lahu fīh.
occasion-55-1.translation: O Allah, forgive so-and-so (naming him), raise his rank among the rightly guided, and be his successor among those he leaves behind. Forgive us and him, O Lord of the worlds, make his grave spacious for him and give him light in it.

reference.en: Muslim 2/634
reference.ar: مسلم 2/ 634

occasion-56-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اِغْفِرْ لَهُ وَاِرْحَمْهُ، وَعَافِهِ، وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ، وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّهِ مِنْ الخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلًا خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهِ، وَأَدْخِلْهُ الجَنَّةَ، وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ [وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ]
occasion-56-1.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir lahu warḥamh, wa ʿāfihi waʿfu ʿanh, wa akrim nuzulah, wa wassiʿ mudkhalah, waghsilhu bil-māʾi wath-thalji wal-barad, wa naqqihi minal-khaṭāyā kamā naqqaytath-thawbal-abyaḍa minad-danas, wa abdilhu dāran khayran min dārih, wa ahlan khayran min ahlih, wa zawjan khayran min zawjih, wa adkhilhul-jannah, wa aʿidhhu min ʿadhābil-qabri wa ʿadhābin-nār.
occasion-56-1.translation: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him, keep him safe and pardon him, honour his reception and make his entrance wide. Wash him with water, snow and hail, and cleanse him of sins as You cleanse a white garment of dirt. Give him a home better than his home, a family better than his family and a spouse better than his spouse. Admit him to Paradise and protect him from the punishment of the grave [and the punishment of the Fire].

reference.en: Muslim 2/663
reference.ar: مسلم 2/ 663

occasion-56-2.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اِغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا، وَمَيِّتِنَا، وَشَاهِدِنَا، وَغَائِبِنَا، وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا، وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا. اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الإِسْلَامِ، وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الإِيمَانِ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ وَلَا تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَهُ
occasion-56-2.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir liḥayyinā wa mayyitinā, wa shāhidinā wa ghāʾibinā, wa ṣaghīrinā wa kabīrinā, wa dhakarinā wa unthānā. Allāhumma man aḥyaytahu minnā fa aḥyihi ʿalal-islām, wa man tawaffaytahu minnā fa tawaffahu ʿalal-īmān. Allāhumma lā taḥrimnā ajrahu wa lā tuḍillanā baʿdah.
occasion-56-2.translation: O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our men and our women. O Allah, whoever of us You keep alive, keep him alive upon Islam, and whoever of us You take, take him upon faith. O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward and do not let us go astray after him.

reference.en: Ibn Majah 1/480; Ahmad 2/368; see also Sahih Ibn Majah 1/251
reference.ar: ابن ماجة 1/ 480 وأحمد 2/ 368 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجة 1/ 251

occasion-56-3.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ فُلَانَ بْنَ فُلَانٍ فِي ذِمَّتِكَ، وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ، فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ القَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الوَفَاءِ وَالحَقِّ، فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَاِرْحَمْهُ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
occasion-56-3.transliteration: Allāhumma inna fulānabna fulānin fī dhimmatik, wa ḥabli jiwārik, fa qihi min fitnatil-qabri wa ʿadhābin-nār, wa anta ahlul-wafāʾi wal-ḥaqq, faghfir lahu warḥamhu innaka antal-ghafūrur-raḥīm.
occasion-56-3.translation: O Allah, so-and-so son of so-and-so is in Your care and under the bond of Your protection, so shield him from the trial of the grave and the punishment of the Fire. You are the One who fulfils promises and the One of truth, so forgive him and have mercy on him; truly You are the Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.

reference.en: Ibn Majah, see also Sahih Ibn Majah 1/251; Abu Dawud 3/211
reference.ar: أخرجه ابن ماجة، انظر صحيح ابن ماجة 1/ 251 ورواه أبو داود 3/ 211

occasion-56-4.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَبْدُكَ وَاِبْنُ أَمَتِكَ اِحْتَاجَ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهِ، إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِنًا فَزِدْ فِي حَسَنَاتِهِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسِيئًا فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهُ
occasion-56-4.transliteration: Allāhumma ʿabduka wabnu amatik, iḥtāja ilā raḥmatik, wa anta ghaniyyun ʿan ʿadhābih, in kāna muḥsinan fazid fī ḥasanātih, wa in kāna musīʾan fatajāwaz ʿanh.
occasion-56-4.translation: O Allah, Your servant, the son of Your female servant, is in need of Your mercy, and You have no need to punish him. If he did good, increase his good deeds, and if he did wrong, overlook it.

reference.en: Al-Hakim, who graded it authentic, and adh-Dhahabi agreed 1/359; see also Ahkam al-Janaiz by al-Albani p. 125
reference.ar: أخرجه الحاكم وصحّحه ووافقه الذّهبيّ 1/ 359 وانظر أحكام الجنائز للألبانيّ ص 125

occasion-57-1.translation: O Allah, protect him from the punishment of the grave.

reference.en: Said ibn al-Musayyib said: I prayed behind Abu Hurayrah over a child who had never committed a single sin, and I heard him say: (the supplication). Malik in al-Muwatta 1/288; Ibn Abi Shaybah in al-Musannaf 3/217; al-Bayhaqi 4/9; its chain was graded authentic by Shuayb al-Arnaut in his checking of Sharh as-Sunnah by al-Baghawi 5/357
reference.ar: قال سعيد بن المسيّب صلّيت وراء أبي هريرة على صبيّ لم يعمل خطيئة قطّ فسمعته يقول: 'الحديث'. أخرجه مالك في الموطّأ 1/ 288 وابن أبي شيبة في المصنّف 3/ 217 والبيهقي 4/ 9، وصحّح إسناده شعيب الأرناؤوط في تحقيقه لشرح السّنّة للبغوي 5/ 357

occasion-57-2.arabic: وَإِنْ قَالَ: (اللَّهُمَّ اِجْعَلْهُ فَرَطًا وَذُخْرًا لِوَالِدَيْهِ، وَشَفِيعًا مُجَابًا. اللَّهُمَّ ثَقِّلْ بِهِ مَوَازِينَهُمَا وَأَعْظِمْ بِهِ أُجُورَهُمَا وَأَلْحِقْهُ بِصَالِحِ المُؤْمِنِينَ، وَاِجْعَلْهُ فِي كَفَالَةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَقِهِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ عَذَابَ الجَحِيمِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلًا خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ اِغْفِرْ لِأَسْلَافِنَا وَأَفْرَاطِنَا، وَمَنْ سَبَقَنَا بِالإِيمَانِ) فَحَسَنٌ
occasion-57-2.transliteration: Allāhummajʿalhu faraṭan wa dhukhran liwālidayh, wa shafīʿan mujābā. Allāhumma thaqqil bihi mawāzīnahumā wa aʿẓim bihi ujūrahumā, wa alḥiqhu biṣāliḥil-muʾminīn, wajʿalhu fī kafālati Ibrāhīm, wa qihi biraḥmatika ʿadhābal-jaḥīm, wa abdilhu dāran khayran min dārih, wa ahlan khayran min ahlih. Allāhummaghfir liʾaslāfinā wa afrāṭinā wa man sabaqanā bil-īmān.
occasion-57-2.translation: And if he says: (O Allah, make him a forerunner and a stored treasure for his parents, and an intercessor whose intercession is accepted. O Allah, through him make their scales heavy and their rewards great, join him with the righteous believers, place him in the care of Ibrahim, and by Your mercy protect him from the punishment of Hellfire. Give him a home better than his home and a family better than his family. O Allah, forgive those of us who have gone before, our little ones who have gone ahead, and those who preceded us in faith), that is good.

reference.en: See also al-Mughni by Ibn Qudamah 3/416; ad-Durus al-Muhimmah li-Ammat al-Ummah by Shaykh Abd al-Aziz ibn Abdullah ibn Baz (may Allah have mercy on him) p. 15
reference.ar: انظر: المغني لابن قدامة 3/ 416 والدّروس المهمّة لعامة الأمة للشيخ عبد العزيز بن عبداللّه بن باز رحمه اللّه ص 15

occasion-57-3.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اِجْعَلْهُ لَنَا فَرَطًا، وَسَلَفًا، وَأَجْرًا
occasion-57-3.transliteration: Allāhummajʿalhu lanā faraṭan wa salafan wa ajrā.
occasion-57-3.translation: O Allah, make him for us a forerunner, one who has gone ahead, and a reward.

reference.en: Al-Hasan used to recite the Opening of the Book over a child and say: (the supplication). Al-Baghawi in Sharh as-Sunnah 5/357; Abd ar-Razzaq no. 6588; al-Bukhari cited it without a chain in the Book of Funerals 65, chapter on reciting the Opening of the Book over the deceased 2/113
reference.ar: كان الحَسَن يقرأ على الطّفل بفاتحة الكتاب ويقول: 'الحديث'. أخرجه البغوي في شرح السّنّة 5/ 357، وعبد الرزّاق برقم 6588، وعلّقه البخاري في كتاب الجنائز 65 باب قراءة فاتحة الكتاب على الجنازة 2/ 113

occasion-58-1.arabic: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى ... فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ
occasion-58-1.transliteration: Inna lillāhi mā akhadh, wa lahu mā aʿṭā, wa kullu shayʾin ʿindahu biʾajalin musammā, faltaṣbir waltaḥtasib.
occasion-58-1.translation: To Allah belongs what He has taken, and to Him belongs what He has given, and everything with Him has an appointed term... so be patient and hope for the reward.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 2/80; Muslim 2/636
reference.ar: البخاري 2/ 80 ومسلم 2/ 636

occasion-58-2.arabic: وَإِنْ قَالَ: (أَعْظَمَ اللَّهُ أَجْرَكَ، وَأَحْسَنَ عَزَاءَكَ وَغَفَرَ لِمَيِّتِكَ) فَحَسَنٌ
occasion-58-2.transliteration: Aʿẓamallāhu ajrak, wa aḥsana ʿazāʾak, wa ghafara limayyitik.
occasion-58-2.translation: And if he says: (May Allah make your reward great, grant you good consolation and forgive your deceased), that is good.

reference.en: Al-Adhkar by an-Nawawi p. 126
reference.ar: الأذكار للنّووي ص 126

occasion-59-1.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
occasion-59-1.translation: In the name of Allah, and according to the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 3/314 with an authentic chain; Ahmad with the wording: In the name of Allah and upon the religion of the Messenger of Allah, and its chain is authentic
reference.ar: أبو داود 3/ 314 بسند صحيح وأحمد بلفظ: بسم اللّه وعلى ملّة رسول اللّه. وسنده صحيح

occasion-60-1.translation: O Allah, forgive him. O Allah, make him firm.

reference.en: When the Prophet (peace be upon him) finished burying the deceased, he would stand by the grave and say: (Ask forgiveness for your brother and ask that he be made firm, for he is now being questioned.) Abu Dawud 3/315; al-Hakim, who graded it authentic, and adh-Dhahabi agreed 1/370
reference.ar: كان النّبيّ صلّى اللّه عليه وسلّم إذا فرغ من دفن الميّت وقف عليه وقال: (استغفروا لأخيكم وسلوا له التّثبيت، فإنّه الآن يُسأل). أبو داود 3/ 315، والحاكم وصحّحه ووافقه الذّهبيّ 1/ 370

occasion-61-1.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ، مِنَ المُؤْمِنِينَ وَالمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُونَ [وَيَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ المُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنَّا وَالمُسْتَأْخِرِينَ] أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ العَافِيَةَ
occasion-61-1.transliteration: As-salāmu ʿalaykum ahlad-diyār, minal-muʾminīna wal-muslimīn, wa innā in shāʾallāhu bikum lāḥiqūn, wa yarḥamullāhul-mustaqdimīna minnā wal-mustaʾkhirīn, asʾalullāha lanā wa lakumul-ʿāfiyah.
occasion-61-1.translation: Peace be upon you, O dwellers of these homes, believers and Muslims. We will, if Allah wills, be joining you [may Allah have mercy on those of us who have gone ahead and those who come later]. I ask Allah for well-being for us and for you.

reference.en: Muslim 2/671; Ibn Majah 1/494, the wording being his, from Buraydah (may Allah be pleased with him); the words in square brackets are from the hadith of Aishah (may Allah be pleased with her) in Muslim 2/671
reference.ar: مسلم 2/ 671، وابن ماجة، واللفظ له 1/ 494 عن بريدة رضي اللّه عنه، وما بين المعكوفين من حديث عائشة رضي اللّه عنها عند مسلم 2/ 671

occasion-84-1.arabic: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا اِبْتَلَاكَ بِهِ وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلًا
occasion-84-1.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāhil-ladhī ʿāfānī mimmabtalāka bih, wa faḍḍalanī ʿalā kathīrin mimman khalaqa tafḍīlā.
occasion-84-1.translation: Praise be to Allah who has spared me what He has afflicted you with, and has greatly favoured me over much of what He has created.

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi 5/493 and 494; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/153
reference.ar: التّرمذي 5/ 493 و 494 وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 153

occasion-125-1.arabic: ضَعْ يَدَكَ عَلَى الذِي تَأَلَّمَ مِنْ جَسَدِكَ وَقُلْ: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ) ثَلَاثًا. وَقُلْ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ: (أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ)
occasion-125-1.transliteration: Bismillāh. Aʿūdhu billāhi wa qudratihi min sharri mā ajidu wa uḥādhir.
occasion-125-1.translation: Place your hand on the part of your body that hurts and say 'In the name of Allah' three times, and say seven times: 'I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and what I fear.'

reference.en: Muslim 4/1728
reference.ar: مسلم 4/ 1728

occasion-126-1.arabic: إِذَا رَأَى أَحَدُكُمْ مِنْ أَخِيهِ، أَوْ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ، أَوْ مِنْ مَالِهِ مَا يُعْجِبُهُ [فَلْيَدْعُ لَهُ بِالبَرَكَةِ] فَإِنَّ العَيْنَ حَقٌّ
occasion-126-1.translation: If one of you sees something in his brother, in himself or in his wealth that he admires, [let him pray for blessing upon it,] for the evil eye is real.

reference.en: Musnad Ahmad 4/447; Ibn Majah; Malik; graded authentic by al-Albani in Sahih al-Jami' 1/212; see also al-Arna'ut's edition of Zad al-Ma'ad 4/170
reference.ar: مسند أحمد 4/ 447 وابن ماجة، ومالك، وصحّحه الألباني في صحيح الجامع 1/ 212 وانظر تحقيق زاد المعاد للأرناؤوط 4/ 170

occasion-48-1.arabic: (بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي المَوْهُوبِ لَكَ، وَشَكَرْتَ الوَاهِبَ، وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ، وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ) وَيَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ المُهَنَّأُ فَيَقُولُ: (بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا، وَرَزَقَكَ اللَّهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَأَجْزَلَ ثَوَابَكَ)
occasion-48-1.transliteration: Bārakallāhu laka fil-mawhūbi lak, wa shakartal-wāhib, wa balagha ashuddah, wa ruziqta birrah. Bārakallāhu laka wa bāraka ʿalayk, wa jazākallāhu khayrā, wa razaqakallāhu mithlah, wa ajzala thawābak.
occasion-48-1.translation: (May Allah bless you in the one He has given you; may you be thankful to the Giver; may the child reach full maturity; and may you be granted the child's dutifulness.) The one congratulated replies: (May Allah bless you and shower His blessings upon you, may Allah reward you with good, may Allah grant you the like of it, and may He make your reward abundant.)

reference.en: See also al-Adhkar by an-Nawawi p. 349; Sahih al-Adhkar by Salim al-Hilali 2/713
reference.ar: انظر الأذكار للنّووي ص 349 وصحيح الأذكار للنّووي لسليم الهلالي 2/ 713

occasion-49-1.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُعَوِّذُ الحَسَنَ وَالحُسَيْنَ: (أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ}
occasion-49-1.transliteration: Uʿīdhukumā bikalimātillāhit-tāmmati min kulli shayṭānin wa hāmmah, wa min kulli ʿaynin lāmmah.
occasion-49-1.translation: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to seek protection for al-Hasan and al-Husayn, saying: (I seek protection for you both in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and every poisonous creature, and from every harmful evil eye.)

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 4/119, from the hadith of Ibn Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them both)
reference.ar: البخاري 4/ 119 من حديث ابن عبّاس رضي اللّه عنهما

occasion-80-1.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
occasion-80-1.transliteration: Bārakallāhu lak, wa bāraka ʿalayk, wa jamaʿa baynakumā fī khayr.
occasion-80-1.translation: May Allah bless you, shower His blessings upon you, and bring you both together in goodness.

reference.en: Reported by the compilers of the Sunan except an-Nasa'i; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 1/316
reference.ar: أخرجه أصحاب السّنن إلّا النّسائي وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 1/ 316

occasion-81-1.arabic: إِذَا تَزَوَّجَ أَحَدُكُمْ اِمْرَأَةً، أَوْ إِذَا اِشْتَرَى خَادِمًا فَلْيَقُلْ: (اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ) وَإِذَا اِشْتَرَى بَعِيرًا فَلْيَأْخُذْ بِذِرْوَةِ سَنَامِهِ وَلْيَقُلْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ
occasion-81-1.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayrahā wa khayra mā jabaltahā ʿalayhi wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā wa sharri mā jabaltahā ʿalayh.
occasion-81-1.translation: When one of you marries a woman or buys a servant, let him say: "O Allah, I ask You for her good and the good of the nature You have created in her, and I seek refuge in You from her evil and the evil of the nature You have created in her." And when he buys a camel, let him take hold of the top of its hump and say the same.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 2/248; Ibn Majah 1/617; see also Sahih Ibn Majah 1/324
reference.ar: أبو داود 2/ 248 وابن ماجة 1/ 617 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجة 1/ 324

occasion-82-1.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ وَجَنِّبْ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا
occasion-82-1.transliteration: Bismillāh, Allāhumma jannibnash-shayṭāna wa jannibish-shayṭāna mā razaqtanā.
occasion-82-1.translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep the devil away from us and keep the devil away from what You bestow upon us.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 6/141; Muslim 2/1028
reference.ar: البخاري 6/ 141 ومسلم 2/ 1028

occasion-62-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا
occasion-62-1.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayrahā, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā.
occasion-62-1.translation: O Allah, I ask You for its good, and I seek refuge in You from its evil.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 4/326; Ibn Majah 2/1228; see also Sahih Ibn Majah 2/305
reference.ar: أخرجه أبو داود 4/ 326 وابن ماجة 2/ 1228 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجة 2/ 305

occasion-62-2.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ
occasion-62-2.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayrahā, wa khayra mā fīhā, wa khayra mā ursilat bih, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā, wa sharri mā fīhā, wa sharri mā ursilat bih.
occasion-62-2.translation: O Allah, I ask You for its good, the good within it and the good it has been sent with, and I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil within it and the evil it has been sent with.

reference.en: Muslim 2/616; al-Bukhari 4/76
reference.ar: مسلم 2/ 616 والبخاري 4/ 76

occasion-63-1.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
occasion-63-1.transliteration: Subḥānal-ladhī yusabbiḥur-raʿdu biḥamdihi wal-malāʾikatu min khīfatih.
occasion-63-1.translation: Glory be to the One whose praise the thunder glorifies, and the angels too, in awe of Him.

reference.en: Whenever Abdullah ibn az-Zubayr (may Allah be pleased with them both) heard thunder, he would stop talking and say: (these words). Al-Muwatta 2/992; al-Albani said: its chain is authentic as the saying of a Companion
reference.ar: كان عبداللّه بن الزّبير رضي اللّه عنهما إذا سَمِعَ الرّعد ترك الحديث وقال: '...'، الموطّأ 2/ 992 وقال الألبانيّ: صحيح الإسناد موقوفا

occasion-64-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اَسْقِنَا غَيْثًا مُغِيثًا مَرِيئًا مَرِيعًا، نَافِعًا غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ، عَاجِلًا غَيْرَ آجِلٍ
occasion-64-1.transliteration: Allāhummasqinā ghaythan mughīthan marīʾan marīʿā, nāfiʿan ghayra ḍārr, ʿājilan ghayra ājil.
occasion-64-1.translation: O Allah, give us rain that relieves, wholesome and fruitful, beneficial and not harmful, soon and not delayed.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 1/303; graded authentic by al-Albani in Sahih Abi Dawud 1/216
reference.ar: أبو داود 1/ 303 وصحّحه الألباني في صحيح أبي داود 1/ 216

occasion-64-2.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا
occasion-64-2.transliteration: Allāhumma aghithnā, Allāhumma aghithnā, Allāhumma aghithnā.
occasion-64-2.translation: O Allah, send us rain. O Allah, send us rain. O Allah, send us rain.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 1/224; Muslim 2/613
reference.ar: البخاري 1/ 224 ومسلم 2/ 613

occasion-64-3.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِ عِبَادَكَ، وَبَهَائِمَكَ، وَانْشُرْ رَحْمَتَكَ، وَأَحْيِي بَلَدَكَ المَيِّتَ
occasion-64-3.transliteration: Allāhummasqi ʿibādaka wa bahāʾimak, wanshur raḥmatak, wa aḥyi baladakal-mayyit.
occasion-64-3.translation: O Allah, give water to Your servants and Your animals, spread Your mercy, and bring Your dead land back to life.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 1/305; graded good by al-Albani in Sahih Abi Dawud 1/218
reference.ar: أبو داود 1/ 305 وحسّنه الألباني في صحيح أبي داود 1/ 218

occasion-65-1.translation: O Allah, let it be a beneficial rain.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 2/518
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 2/ 518

occasion-66-1.translation: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 1/205; Muslim 1/83
reference.ar: البخاري 1/ 205 ومسلم 1/ 83

occasion-67-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلَا عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ، وَبُطُونِ الأَوْدِيَةِ، وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ
occasion-67-1.transliteration: Allāhumma ḥawālaynā wa lā ʿalaynā, Allāhumma ʿalal-ākāmi waẓ-ẓirāb, wa buṭūnil-awdiyah, wa manābitish-shajar.
occasion-67-1.translation: O Allah, around us and not upon us. O Allah, upon the hills and the high ground, the valley floors and the places where trees grow.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 1/224; Muslim 2/614
reference.ar: البخاري 1/ 224 ومسلم 2/ 614

occasion-68-1.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ. اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالأَمْنِ وَالإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالإِسْلَامِ، وَالتَّوْفِيقِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضَى. رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
occasion-68-1.transliteration: Allāhu akbar. Allāhumma ahillahu ʿalaynā bil-amni wal-īmān, was-salāmati wal-islām, wat-tawfīqi limā tuḥibbu rabbanā wa tarḍā. Rabbunā wa rabbukallāh.
occasion-68-1.translation: Allah is the Greatest. O Allah, bring it upon us with security and faith, with safety and Islam, and with success in what You love and are pleased with, our Lord. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi 5/504; ad-Darimi, with this wording, 1/336; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/157
reference.ar: التّرمذي 5/ 504 والدّارمي بلفظه 1/ 336 وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 157

occasion-77-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي ثَمَرِنَا، وبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَدِينَتِنَا وبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي صَاعِنَا، وبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مُدِّنَا
occasion-77-1.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lanā fī thamarinā, wa bārik lanā fī madīnatinā, wa bārik lanā fī ṣāʿinā, wa bārik lanā fī muddinā.
occasion-77-1.translation: O Allah, bless us in our fruit, bless us in our city, bless us in our sa' and bless us in our mudd.

reference.en: Muslim 2/1000
reference.ar: مسلم 2/ 1000

occasion-111-1.arabic: إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ صِيَاحَ الدِّيَكَةِ فَاسْأَلُوا اللَّهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ، فَإِنَّهَا رَأَتْ مَلَكًا. وَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نَهِيقَ الحِمَارَ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ، فَإِنَّهُ رَأَى شَيْطَانًا
occasion-111-1.translation: When you hear roosters crowing, ask Allah for His bounty, for they have seen an angel. And when you hear a donkey braying, seek refuge in Allah from Satan, for it has seen a devil.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 6/350; Muslim 4/2092
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 6/ 350 ومسلم 4/ 2092

occasion-112-1.arabic: إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نُبَاحَ الكِلَابِ وَنَهِيقَ الحَمِيرِ بِاللَّيْلِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ، فَإِنَّهُنَّ يَرَيْنَ مَا لَا تَرَوْنَ
occasion-112-1.translation: When you hear dogs barking or donkeys braying at night, seek refuge in Allah from them, for they see what you do not see.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 4/327; Ahmad 3/306; graded authentic by al-Albani in Sahih Abi Dawud 3/961
reference.ar: أبو داود 4/ 327 وأحمد 3/ 306 وصحّحه الألباني في صحيح أبي داود 3/ 961

occasion-69-1.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ العُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
occasion-69-1.transliteration: Dhahabaẓ-ẓamaʾu wabtallatil-ʿurūq, wa thabatal-ajru in shāʾallāh.
occasion-69-1.translation: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is assured, if Allah wills.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 2/306 and others; see also Sahih al-Jami 4/209
reference.ar: أخرجه أبو داود 2/ 306 وغيره، وانظر صحيح الجامع 4/ 209

occasion-69-2.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ التِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي
occasion-69-2.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka biraḥmatikal-latī wasiʿat kulla shayʾin an taghfira lī.
occasion-69-2.translation: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy, which encompasses all things, to forgive me.

reference.en: Ibn Majah 1/557, from the supplication of Abdullah ibn Amr (may Allah be pleased with them both); graded good by al-Hafiz in his takhrij of al-Adhkar; see also Sharh al-Adhkar 4/342
reference.ar: أخرجه ابن ماجة 1/ 557 من دعاء عبد اللّه بن عمرو رضي اللّه عنهما، وحسّنه الحافظ في تخريج الأذكار انظر شرح الأذكار 4/ 342

occasion-70-1.arabic: إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ طَعَامًا فَلْيَقُلْ: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ)، فَإِنْ نَسِيَ فِي أَوَّلِهِ فَلْيَقُلْ: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ)
occasion-70-1.transliteration: Bismillāh. Bismillāhi fī awwalihi wa ākhirih.
occasion-70-1.translation: When one of you eats food, let him say: (In the name of Allah). If he forgets at the beginning, let him say: (In the name of Allah at its beginning and at its end).

reference.en: Abu Dawud 3/347; at-Tirmidhi 4/288; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 2/167
reference.ar: أخرجه أبو داود 3/ 347 والتّرمذي 4/ 288 وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 2/ 167

occasion-70-2.arabic: مَنْ أَطْعَمَهُ اللَّهُ الطَّعَامَ فَلْيَقُلْ: (اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْرًا مِنْهُ)، وَمَنْ سَقَاهُ اللَّهُ لَبَنًا فَلْيَقُلْ: (اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ)
occasion-70-2.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi wa aṭʿimnā khayran minh. Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi wa zidnā minh.
occasion-70-2.translation: Whoever Allah has given food, let him say: (O Allah, bless it for us and feed us with better than it). And whoever Allah has given milk to drink, let him say: (O Allah, bless it for us and give us more of it).

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi 5/506; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/158
reference.ar: التّرمذي 5/ 506 وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 158

occasion-71-1.arabic: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا، وَرَزَقَنِيهِ، مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
occasion-71-1.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāhil-ladhī aṭʿamanī hādhā, wa razaqanīh, min ghayri ḥawlin minnī wa lā quwwah.
occasion-71-1.translation: Praise be to Allah who has fed me this and provided it for me, without any might or power on my part.

reference.en: Reported by the compilers of the Sunan except an-Nasa'i; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/159
reference.ar: أخرجه أصحاب السّنن إلّا النّسائي، وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 159

occasion-71-2.arabic: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ، غَيْرَ [مَكْفِيٍّ وَلَا] مُوَدَّعٍ، وَلَا مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا
occasion-71-2.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāhi ḥamdan kathīran ṭayyiban mubārakan fīh, ghayra makfiyyin wa lā muwaddaʿ, wa lā mustaghnan ʿanhu rabbanā.
occasion-71-2.translation: Praise be to Allah, abundant, good and blessed praise, [a praise that is never sufficient, nor] bidden farewell, nor ever dispensed with, our Lord.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 6/214; at-Tirmidhi 5/507, with this wording
reference.ar: البخاري 6/ 214 والتّرمذي بلفظه 5/ 507

occasion-72-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
occasion-72-1.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lahum fīmā razaqtahum, waghfir lahum warḥamhum.
occasion-72-1.translation: O Allah, bless them in what You have provided for them, forgive them and have mercy on them.

reference.en: Muslim 3/1615
reference.ar: مسلم 3/ 1615

occasion-73-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَنْ أَطْعَمَنِي وَاسْقِ مَنْ سَقَانِي
occasion-73-1.transliteration: Allāhumma aṭʿim man aṭʿamanī wasqi man saqānī.
occasion-73-1.translation: O Allah, feed the one who fed me and give drink to the one who gave me drink.

reference.en: Muslim 3/126
reference.ar: مسلم 3/ 126

occasion-74-1.arabic: أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ، وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الأَبْرَارُ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ المَلَائِكَةُ
occasion-74-1.transliteration: Afṭara ʿindakumuṣ-ṣāʾimūn, wa akala ṭaʿāmakumul-abrār, wa ṣallat ʿalaykumul-malāʾikah.
occasion-74-1.translation: May those who are fasting break their fast with you, may the righteous eat your food, and may the angels pray for you.

reference.en: Sunan Abi Dawud 3/367; Ibn Majah 1/556; an-Nasa'i in Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah nos. 296-298, who stated that the Prophet (peace be upon him) would say it when he broke his fast with a household; al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih Abi Dawud 2/730
reference.ar: سنن أبي داود 3/ 367، وابن ماجة 1/ 556، والنّسائي في عمل اليوم واللّيلة برقم: 296 - 298، ونصّ على أنّه صلّى اللّه عليه وسلّم يقوله إذا أفطر عند أهل بيت، وصحّحه الألباني في صحيح أبي داود 2/ 730

occasion-75-1.arabic: (إِذَا دُعِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيُجِبْ، فَإِنْ كَانَ صَائِمًا فَلْيُصَلِّ وَإِنْ كَانَ مُفْطِرًا فَلْيَطْعَمْ). وَمَعْنَى فَلْيُصَلِّ أَيْ: فَلْيَدْعُ
occasion-75-1.translation: "When one of you is invited, let him accept. If he is fasting, let him pray, and if he is not fasting, let him eat." The meaning of "let him pray" is: let him make dua.

reference.en: Muslim 2/1054
reference.ar: مسلم 2/ 1054

occasion-76-1.translation: I am fasting, I am fasting.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 4/103; Muslim 2/806
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 4/ 103، ومسلم 2/ 806

occasion-78-1.arabic: إِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَقُلْ: (الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ)، وَلْيَقُلْ لَهُ أَخُوهُ أَوْ صَاحِبُهُ: (يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ)، فَإِذَا قَالَ لَهُ: (يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ)، فَلْيَقُلْ: (يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمُ)
occasion-78-1.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāh. Yarḥamukallāh. Yahdīkumullāhu wa yuṣliḥu bālakum.
occasion-78-1.translation: When one of you sneezes, let him say: "Praise be to Allah (al-hamdu lillah)," and let his brother or companion say to him: "May Allah have mercy on you (yarhamukallah)." When he says to him "May Allah have mercy on you," let him reply: "May Allah guide you and set your affairs right."

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 7/125
reference.ar: البخاري 7/ 125

occasion-79-1.translation: May Allah guide you and set your affairs right.

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi 5/82; Ahmad 4/400; Abu Dawud 4/308; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 2/354
reference.ar: التّرمذي 5/ 82 وأحمد 4/ 400 وأبو داود 4/ 308، وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 2/ 354

reference.en: Ahmad 5/82; an-Nasa'i in Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah p. 218 no. 421, edited by Dr Faruq Hamadah
reference.ar: أحمد 5/ 82 والنّسائي في عمل اليوم واللّيلة ص 218 برقم 421 تحقيق الدّكتور فاروق حمادة

occasion-88-1.translation: May Allah reward you with good.

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi no. 2035; see also Sahih al-Jami 6244 and Sahih at-Tirmidhi 2/200
reference.ar: أخرجه التّرمذي رقم 2035 وانظر صحيح الجامع 6244 وصحيح التّرمذي 2/ 200

occasion-90-1.translation: May He for whose sake you love me love you.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 4/333; al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Sunan Abi Dawud 3/965
reference.ar: أخرجه أبو داود 4/ 333، وحسّنه الألباني في صحيح سنن أبي داود 3/ 965

occasion-91-1.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ
occasion-91-1.transliteration: Bārakallāhu laka fī ahlika wa mālik.
occasion-91-1.translation: May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 4/88
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 4/ 88

occasion-92-1.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ، إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الحَمْدُ وَالأَدَاءُ
occasion-92-1.transliteration: Bārakallāhu laka fī ahlika wa mālik, innamā jazāʾus-salafil-ḥamdu wal-adāʾ.
occasion-92-1.translation: May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth. The reward for a loan is only praise and repayment.

reference.en: An-Nasa'i in Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah p. 300; Ibn Majah 2/809; see also Sahih Ibn Majah 2/55
reference.ar: أخرجه النّسائي في عمل اليوم واللّيلة ص 300 وابن ماجة 2/ 809 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجة 2/ 55

occasion-94-1.translation: And may Allah bless you too.

reference.en: Ibn as-Sunni p. 138 no. 278; see also Ibn al-Qayyim's al-Wabil as-Sayyib p. 304, edited by Bashir Muhammad Uyun
reference.ar: أخرجه ابن السّني ص 138 برقم 278 وانظر الوابل الصّيب لابن القيّم ص 304 تحقيق بشير محمد عيون

occasion-95-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا طَيْرَ إِلَّا طَيْرُكَ، وَلَا خَيْرَ إِلَّا خَيْرُكَ، وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
occasion-95-1.transliteration: Allāhumma lā ṭayra illā ṭayruk, wa lā khayra illā khayruk, wa lā ilāha ghayruk.
occasion-95-1.translation: O Allah, there is no omen but Your omen, there is no good but Your good, and there is no god other than You.

reference.en: Ahmad 2/220; Ibn as-Sunni no. 292; al-Albani graded it authentic in al-Ahadith as-Sahihah 3/54, no. 1065. As for good omens, the Prophet (peace be upon him) liked them; so when he heard a good word from a man that pleased him, he said: 'We have taken your omen from your mouth.' Abu Dawud and Ahmad; al-Albani graded it authentic in as-Sahihah 2/363, from Abu ash-Shaykh in Akhlaq an-Nabi (peace be upon him) p. 270
reference.ar: أحمد 2/ 220، وابن السني برقم 292، وصححه الألباني في الأحاديث الصحيحة 3/ 54، رقم 1065، أما الفأل فكان يعجب النّبيّ صلّى اللّه عليه وسلّم ولهذا سمع من رجل كلمة طيّبة فأعجبته فقال: (أخذنا فألك من فيك) أبو داود وأحمد، وصححه الألباني في الصحيحة 2/ 363 عند أبي الشيخ في أخلاق النّبيّ صلّى اللّه عليه وسلّم ص 270

occasion-107-1.arabic: كَانَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا أَتَاهُ الأَمْرُ يَسُرُّهُ قَالَ: (الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ) وَإِذَا أَتَاهُ الأَمْرُ يَكْرَهُهُ قَالَ: (الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ)
occasion-107-1.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāhil-ladhī biniʿmatihi tatimmuṣ-ṣāliḥāt. Al-ḥamdu lillāhi ʿalā kulli ḥāl.
occasion-107-1.translation: When something pleasing came to him, the Prophet (peace be upon him) would say: 'All praise is for Allah, by whose favour good things are completed.' And when something displeasing came to him, he would say: 'All praise is for Allah in every circumstance.'

reference.en: Ibn as-Sunni in 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah; al-Hakim 1/499, who graded it authentic; graded authentic by al-Albani in Sahih al-Jami' 4/201
reference.ar: أخرجه ابن السّني في عمل اليوم واللّيلة، والحاكم وصحّحه 1/ 499 وصحّحه الألباني رحمه اللّه في صحيح الجامع 4/ 201

occasion-110-1.arabic: إِذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلُ الكِتَابِ فَقُولُوا: (وَعَلَيْكُمْ)
occasion-110-1.translation: When the People of the Book greet you with salam, say: 'And upon you.'

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 11/42; Muslim 4/1705
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 11/ 42، ومسلم 4/ 1705

occasion-113-1.arabic: قَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (اللَّهُمَّ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ قُرْبَةً إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ القِيَامَةِ)
occasion-113-1.transliteration: Allāhumma fa ayyumā muʾminin sababtuhu fajʿal dhālika lahu qurbatan ilayka yawmal-qiyāmah.
occasion-113-1.translation: He (peace be upon him) said: 'O Allah, whichever believer I have insulted, make that a means of drawing him near to You on the Day of Resurrection.'

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 11/171; Muslim 4/2007, whose wording is: make it a purification and a mercy for him
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 11/ 171 ومسلم 4/ 2007 ولفظه: فاجعلها له زكاة ورحمة

occasion-114-1.arabic: قَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُمُ مَادِحًا صَاحِبَهُ لَا مَحَالَةَ، فَلْيَقُلْ: أَحْسَبُ فُلَانًا وَاللَّهُ حَسِيبُهُ، وَلَا أُزَكِّي عَلَى اللَّهِ أَحَدًا، أَحْسِبُهُ - إِنْ كَانَ يَعْلَمُ ذَاكَ - كَذَا وَكَذَا)
occasion-114-1.transliteration: Aḥsabu fulānan wallāhu ḥasībuh, wa lā uzakkī ʿalallāhi aḥadā, aḥsibuhu in kāna yaʿlamu dhāka kadhā wa kadhā.
occasion-114-1.translation: He (peace be upon him) said: 'If one of you must praise his companion, let him say: I consider so-and-so to be so, and Allah is the one who will take account of him, and I do not vouch for anyone before Allah; I consider him, if he knows that about him, to be such and such.'

reference.en: Muslim 4/2296
reference.ar: رواه مسلم 4/ 2296

occasion-115-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ، وَاِغْفِرْ لِي مَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ [وَاِجْعَلْنِي خَيْرًا مِمَّا يَظُنُّونَ]
occasion-115-1.transliteration: Allāhumma lā tuʾākhidhnī bimā yaqūlūn, waghfir lī mā lā yaʿlamūn, wajʿalnī khayran mimmā yaẓunnūn.
occasion-115-1.translation: O Allah, do not hold me to account for what they say, and forgive me for what they do not know [and make me better than they think].

reference.en: Al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-Mufrad no. 761, whose chain al-Albani graded authentic in Sahih al-Adab al-Mufrad no. 585; the words in square brackets are an addition reported by al-Bayhaqi in Shu'ab al-Iman 4/228 through another chain
reference.ar: البخاري في الأدب المفرد برقم 761، وصحّح إسناده الألباني في صحيح الأدب المفرد برقم 585، وما بين المعكوفين زيادة للبيهقي في شعب الإيمان 4/ 228 من طريق آخر.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 1/210, 390 and 414; Muslim 4/1857
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 1/ 210 و 390 و 414 ومسلم 4/ 1857

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 8/441; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 2/103 and 2/235; Musnad Ahmad 5/218
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 8/ 441 وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 2/ 103 و 2/ 235 ومسند أحمد 5/ 218

occasion-124-1.arabic: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا أَتَاهُ أَمْرٌ يَسُرُّهُ أَوْ يُسَرُّ بِهِ خَرَّ سَاجِدًا شُكْرًا لِلَّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى
occasion-124-1.translation: Whenever something came to the Prophet (peace be upon him) that pleased him, or that he was made glad by, he would fall down in prostration in thanks to Allah, the Blessed and Exalted.

reference.en: Reported by the authors of the Sunan except an-Nasa'i; see also Sahih Ibn Majah 1/233 and Irwa' al-Ghalil 2/226
reference.ar: رواه أهل السّنن إلّا النّسائي. انظر صحيح ابن ماجة 1/ 233 وإرواء الغليل 2/ 226

occasion-96-1.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، {سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ} الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاِغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
occasion-96-1.transliteration: Bismillāh, wal-ḥamdu lillāh. Subḥānal-ladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahu muqrinīn, wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūn. Al-ḥamdu lillāh, al-ḥamdu lillāh, al-ḥamdu lillāh, Allāhu akbar, Allāhu akbar, Allāhu akbar. Subḥānakallāhumma innī ẓalamtu nafsī faghfir lī, fa innahu lā yaghfirudh-dhunūba illā ant.
occasion-96-1.translation: In the name of Allah, and praise be to Allah. "Glory be to the One who has subjected this to us, for we could never have done it ourselves; and to our Lord we will surely return" (Az-Zukhruf 43:13-14). Praise be to Allah, praise be to Allah, praise be to Allah. Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. Glory be to You, O Allah, I have wronged myself, so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 3/34; at-Tirmidhi 5/501; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/156
reference.ar: أبو داود 3/ 34 والتّرمذي 5/ 501 وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 156

occasion-97-1.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، {سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ} اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا البِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ العَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالخَلِيفَةُ فِي الأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ المَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ المُنْقَلَبِ فِي المَالِ وَالأَهْلِ. وَإِذَا رَجَعَ قَالَهُنَّ وَزَادَ فِيهِنَّ: (آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ)
occasion-97-1.transliteration: Allāhu akbar, Allāhu akbar, Allāhu akbar. Subḥānal-ladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahu muqrinīn, wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūn. Allāhumma innā nasʾaluka fī safarinā hādhal-birra wat-taqwā, wa minal-ʿamali mā tarḍā. Allāhumma hawwin ʿalaynā safaranā hādhā waṭwi ʿannā buʿdah. Allāhumma antaṣ-ṣāḥibu fis-safar, wal-khalīfatu fil-ahl. Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min waʿthāʾis-safar, wa kaʾābatil-manẓar, wa sūʾil-munqalabi fil-māli wal-ahl.
occasion-97-1.translation: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. "Glory be to the One who has subjected this to us, for we could never have done it ourselves; and to our Lord we will surely return" (Az-Zukhruf 43:13-14). O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey of ours easy for us and fold up its distance for us. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the One who looks after the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardships of travel, from a distressing sight, and from an evil outcome in wealth and family. And when he returned, he said them and added: "We return, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord."

reference.en: Muslim 2/998
reference.ar: مسلم 2/ 998

occasion-98-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الأَرَضِينِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَقْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَمَا أَضْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَيْنَ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ القَرْيَةِ وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا
occasion-98-1.transliteration: Allāhumma rabbas-samāwātis-sabʿi wa mā aẓlalna, wa rabbal-araḍīnas-sabʿi wa mā aqlalna, wa rabbash-shayāṭīni wa mā aḍlalna, wa rabbar-riyāḥi wa mā dharayna, asʾaluka khayra hādhihil-qaryati wa khayra ahlihā, wa khayra mā fīhā, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā, wa sharri ahlihā, wa sharri mā fīhā.
occasion-98-1.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all they shade, Lord of the seven earths and all they carry, Lord of the devils and all they lead astray, Lord of the winds and all they scatter, I ask You for the good of this town, the good of its people and the good of what is in it, and I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil of its people and the evil of what is in it.

reference.en: Al-Hakim 2/100, who graded it authentic, and adh-Dhahabi agreed; Ibn as-Sunni no. 524; al-Hafiz graded it good in Takhrij al-Adhkar 5/154. Ibn Baz said: an-Nasa'i also reported it with a good chain. See Tuhfat al-Akhyar p. 37
reference.ar: الحاكم وصحّحه ووافقه الذّهبي 2/ 100 وابن السّني برقم 524 وحسّنه الحافظ في تخريج الأذكار 5/ 154، قال ابن باز: ورواه النّسائي بإسناد حسن. انظر تحفة الأخيار ص 37

occasion-99-1.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
occasion-99-1.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamd, yuḥyī wa yumītu wa huwa ḥayyun lā yamūt, biyadihil-khayru wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.
occasion-99-1.translation: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is Ever-Living and does not die. In His hand is all good, and He has power over all things.

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi 5/491; al-Hakim 1/538; al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Ibn Majah 2/21 and in Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/152
reference.ar: التّرمذي 5/ 491 والحاكم 1/ 538 وحسّنه الألباني في صحيح ابن ماجة 2/ 21 وفي صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 152

reference.en: Abu Dawud 4/296; al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih Abi Dawud 3/941
reference.ar: أبو داود 4/ 296 وصحّحه الألباني في صحيح أبي داود 3/ 941

occasion-101-1.arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُكُمُ اللَّهَ الذِي لَا تَضِيعُ وَدَائِعُهُ
occasion-101-1.translation: I leave you in the care of Allah, whose trusts are never lost.

reference.en: Ahmad 2/403; Ibn Majah 2/943; see also Sahih Ibn Majah 2/133
reference.ar: أحمد 2/ 403 وابن ماجة 2/ 943 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجة 2/ 133

occasion-102-1.arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ، وَأَمَانَتَكَ، وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ
occasion-102-1.transliteration: Astawdiʿullāha dīnak, wa amānatak, wa khawātīma ʿamalik.
occasion-102-1.translation: I leave in the care of Allah your religion, your trust, and the final outcome of your deeds.

reference.en: Ahmad 2/7; at-Tirmidhi 5/499; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 2/155
reference.ar: أحمد 2/ 7 والتّرمذي 5/ 499 وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 2/ 155

occasion-102-2.arabic: زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى، وَغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ، وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الخَيْرَ حَيْثُ مَا كُنْتَ
occasion-102-2.transliteration: Zawwadakallāhut-taqwā, wa ghafara dhanbak, wa yassara lakal-khayra ḥaythu mā kunt.
occasion-102-2.translation: May Allah provide you with piety as your provision, forgive your sins, and make good easy for you wherever you may be.

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/155
reference.ar: التّرمذي وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 155

occasion-103-1.arabic: قَالَ جَابِرٌ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: (كُنَّا إِذَا صَعَدْنَا كَبَّرْنَا، وَإِذَا نَزَلْنَا سَبَّحْنَا)
occasion-103-1.translation: Jabir (may Allah be pleased with him) said: "When we went up, we would say Allahu akbar, and when we went down, we would say Subhan Allah."

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 6/135
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 6/ 135

occasion-104-1.arabic: سَمَّـِعَ سَامِعٌ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ، وَحُسْنِ بَلَائِهِ عَلَيْنَا. رَبَّنَا صَاحِبْنَا، وَأَفْضِلْ عَلَيْنَا عَائِذًا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ
occasion-104-1.transliteration: Sammaʿa sāmiʿun biḥamdillāh, wa ḥusni balāʾihi ʿalaynā. Rabbanā ṣāḥibnā, wa afḍil ʿalaynā ʿāʾidhan billāhi minan-nār.
occasion-104-1.translation: May a hearer bear witness to [or: convey] our praise of Allah and His fine favours upon us. Our Lord, be our Companion and bestow Your favour upon us, as we seek refuge in Allah from the Fire.

reference.en: Muslim 4/2086. 'Sami'a sami'' (with a single m) means: a witness has borne witness to our praise of Allah the Exalted for His favours and His fine trials. 'Samma'a sami'' (with a doubled m) means: let a hearer convey these words of mine to others and say the same, as a reminder of remembrance and supplication before dawn. His words 'Our Lord, be our Companion and bestow Your favour upon us' mean: protect us, encompass us, guard us, favour us with Your abundant blessings and turn every hardship away from us. An-Nawawi's commentary 17/39
reference.ar: مسلم 4/ 2086 ومعنى سمِع سامع: أي شهد شاهد على حمدنا للّه تعالى على نعمه وحسن بلائه. ومعنى سمَّع سامع: بلّغ سامع قولي هذا لغيره وقال مثله تنبيها على الذِّكر في السّحر والدعاء. وقوله: ربّنا صاحبنا وأفضل علينا: أي احفظنا وحطنا واكلأنا وأفضل علينا بجزيل نعمك واصرف عنّا كلّ مكروه، شرح النّووي 17/ 39

occasion-105-1.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
occasion-105-1.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bikalimātillāhit-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq.
occasion-105-1.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

reference.en: Muslim 4/2080
reference.ar: مسلم 4/ 2080

occasion-106-1.arabic: يُكِبِّرُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَرَفٍ ثَلَاثَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ، صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ
occasion-106-1.transliteration: Allāhu akbar, Allāhu akbar, Allāhu akbar. Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulk, wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr. Āyibūn, tāʾibūn, ʿābidūn, lirabbinā ḥāmidūn, ṣadaqallāhu waʿdah, wa naṣara ʿabdah, wa hazamal-aḥzāba waḥdah.
occasion-106-1.translation: He would say Allahu akbar three times on every high place, then say: "There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. We return, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord. Allah has fulfilled His promise, given victory to His servant, and defeated the confederates alone."

reference.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) would say it when returning from a military expedition or Hajj. Al-Bukhari 7/163; Muslim 2/980
reference.ar: كان النّبيّ صلّى اللّه عليه وسلّم يقوله إذا قفل من غزو أو حجّ، البخاري 7/ 163 ومسلم 2/ 980

occasion-116-1.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الحَمْدَ، وَالنِّعْمَةَ، لَكَ وَالمُلْكُ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
occasion-116-1.transliteration: Labbayk Allāhumma labbayk, labbayka lā sharīka laka labbayk, innal-ḥamda wan-niʿmata laka wal-mulk, lā sharīka lak.
occasion-116-1.translation: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Truly all praise and blessings are Yours, and all sovereignty. You have no partner.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 3/408; Muslim 2/841
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 3/ 408، ومسلم 2/ 841

occasion-117-1.arabic: طَافَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِالبَيْتِ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ كُلَّمَا أَتَى الرُّكْنَ أَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ بِشَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ وَكَبَّرَ
occasion-117-1.translation: The Prophet (peace be upon him) went around the House on a camel. Every time he came to the corner [of the Black Stone], he pointed at it with something he was holding and said takbir (Allah is the Greatest).

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 3/476; the 'something' means a hooked staff (al-mihjan); see also al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 3/472
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 3/ 476 والمراد بالشيء: المحجن. انظر: البخاري مع الفتح 3/ 472

occasion-118-1.arabic: {رَبَّنَا ءَاتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ}
occasion-118-1.transliteration: Rabbanā ātinā fid-dunyā ḥasanatan wa fil-ākhirati ḥasanatan wa qinā ʿadhāban-nār.
occasion-118-1.translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire. (Al-Baqarah 2:201)

reference.en: Abu Dawud 2/179; Ahmad 3/411; al-Baghawi in Sharh as-Sunnah 7/128; graded good (hasan) by al-Albani in Sahih Abi Dawud 1/354; the verse is from Surat al-Baqarah: 201
reference.ar: أبو داود 2/ 179، وأحمد 3/ 411 والبغوي في شرح السّنّة 7/ 128، وحسّنه الألباني في صحيح أبي داود 1/ 354، والآية من سورة البقرة: 201

occasion-119-1.arabic: لَمَّا دَنَا صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنَ الصَّفَا قَرَأَ {إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَآئِرِ اللَّهِ} (أَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ) فَبَدَأَ بِالصَّفَا فَرَقِيَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى رَأَى البَيْتَ فَاسْتَقْبَلَ القِبْلَةَ فَوَحَّدَ اللَّهَ وَكَبَّرَهُ وَقَالَ: (لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ)، ثُمَّ دَعَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ. قَالَ مِثْلَ هَذَا ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ (الحَدِيثْ). وَفِيهِ: (فَفَعَلَ عَلَى المَرْوَةِ كَمَا فَعَلَ عَلَى الصَّفَا)
occasion-119-1.transliteration: Innaṣ-ṣafā wal-marwata min shaʿāʾirillāh. Abdaʾu bimā badaʾallāhu bih. Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr. Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdah, anjaza waʿdah, wa naṣara ʿabdah, wa hazamal-aḥzāba waḥdah.
occasion-119-1.translation: When he (peace be upon him) drew near to as-Safa, he recited: 'Indeed, as-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah' (Al-Baqarah 2:158), [and said:] 'I begin with what Allah began with.' So he began with as-Safa and climbed it until he could see the House. He faced the qiblah, declared the oneness of Allah and His greatness, and said: 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things capable. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone. He fulfilled His promise, gave victory to His servant, and defeated the confederates alone.' Then he made supplication in between, saying the like of this three times (to the end of the hadith). And in it: 'He did on al-Marwah as he had done on as-Safa.'

reference.en: Muslim 2/888; the verse is from Surat al-Baqarah: 158
reference.ar: مسلم 2/ 888، والآية من سورة البقرة: 158

occasion-120-1.arabic: خَيْرُ الدُّعَاءِ دُعَاءُ يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ، وَخَيْرُ مَا قُلْتُ أَنَا وَالنَّبِيُّونَ مِنْ قَبْلِي: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
occasion-120-1.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.
occasion-120-1.translation: The best supplication is the supplication of the Day of Arafah, and the best of what I and the prophets before me have said is: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things capable.

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi; graded good (hasan) by al-Albani in Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/184 and in al-Ahadith as-Sahihah 4/6
reference.ar: التّرمذي وحسّنه الألباني في صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 184، وفي الأحاديث الصّحيحة 4/ 6

occasion-121-1.arabic: رَكِبَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ القَصْوَاءَ حَتَّى أَتَى المَشْعَرَ الحَرَامَ، فَاسْتَقْبَلَ القِبْلَةَ (فَدَعَاهُ، وَكَبَّرَهُ، وَهَلَّلَهُ، وَوَحَّدَهُ) فَلَمْ يَزَلْ وَاقِفًا حَتَّى أَسْفَرَ جِدًّا، فَدَفَعَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ
occasion-121-1.translation: He (peace be upon him) rode al-Qaswa' until he came to al-Mash'ar al-Haram. He faced the qiblah (and supplicated to Allah, declared His greatness, said la ilaha illallah, and declared His oneness), and remained standing until the dawn light was very bright. Then he moved on before the sun rose.

reference.en: Muslim 2/891
reference.ar: مسلم 2/ 891

occasion-122-1.arabic: يُكَبِّرُ كُلَّمَا رَمَى بِحَصَاةٍ عِنْدَ الجِمَارِ الثَّلَاثِ، ثُمَّ يَتَقَدَّمُ، وَيَقِفُ يَدْعُو مُسْتَقْبِلَ القِبْلَةِ، رَافِعًا يَدَيْهِ بَعْدَ الجَمْرَةِ الأُولَى وَالثَّانِيَةِ. أَمَّا جَمْرَةُ العَقَبَةِ فَيَرْمِيهَا وَيُكَبِّرُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ حَصَاةٍ وَيَنْصَرِفُ وَلَا يَقِفُ عِنْدَهَا
occasion-122-1.translation: He would say takbir (Allah is the Greatest) each time he threw a pebble at the three Jamarat. Then he would step forward and stand facing the qiblah, raising his hands in supplication, after the first and the second Jamrah. As for Jamrat al-Aqabah, he would stone it, saying takbir with every pebble, and then leave without stopping at it.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 3/583 and 3/584, see its wording there; al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 3/581; Muslim also reported it
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح 3/ 583 و 3/ 584، وانظر لفظه هناك. والبخاري مع الفتح 3/ 581 ورواه مسلم أيضا.

occasion-128-1.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، [اللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ]، اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي
occasion-128-1.transliteration: Bismillāhi wallāhu akbar, Allāhumma minka wa lak, Allāhumma taqabbal minnī.
occasion-128-1.translation: In the name of Allah, and Allah is the Greatest. [O Allah, from You and for You.] O Allah, accept it from me.

reference.en: Muslim 3/1557; al-Bayhaqi 9/287; the words in square brackets are from al-Bayhaqi 9/287 and others, and the last sentence is given in meaning from Muslim's narration
reference.ar: مسلم 3/ 1557، والبيهقي 9/ 287/ ومابين المعكوفين للبيهقي 9/ 287، وغيره والجملة الأخيرة سقتها بالمعنى من رواية مسلم
